Verb Phrase (v phr)
Zıt anlamlısı: put on weight. [cite: 327, 329]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I need to lose weight before summer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He lost 10 kilos by going on a diet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How can I lose weight safely?
kayitlar.synonyms: slim down, become thinner, reduce weight, get lighter
kayitlar.antonyms: gain weight, put on weight, get heavier

kayitlar.explanation: To give the impression of being or doing something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v)
Kullanım: to seem + adjective (e.g., comfortable, familiar). [cite: 330, 331]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You seem happy today.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This diet doesn't seem very healthy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The new teacher seems familiar.
kayitlar.synonyms: appear, look, give the impression of, come across as

kayitlar.explanation: To have a lifestyle with many activities, responsibilities, and little free time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: People in big cities often have a busy life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I have a busy life, so I don't have time for quick meals.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She's a doctor, so she has a very busy life.
kayitlar.synonyms: be very busy, lead a hectic life, have a full schedule
kayitlar.antonyms: lead a quiet life, have a simple life

kayitlar.explanation: The quality of being important or significant.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) [cite: 333]
Örnek Kullanım: to have (great) importance. [cite: 334]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The family has great importance in Japan.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He stressed the importance of a balanced diet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is a matter of great importance.

kayitlar.explanation: To produce a change in someone or something; to have an effect on.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v)
Kullanım: to affect somebody / something. [cite: 335]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Your diet affects your health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The weather can affect people's mood.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How does technology affect our cooking customs? [cite: 336]
kayitlar.antonyms: ignore, leave unaffected, be irrelevant to

kayitlar.explanation: To grow or make food, especially in large quantities for sale.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many countries produce their own food.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The farm produces food for the local market.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is expensive to produce food in the city.
kayitlar.synonyms: grow food, make food, manufacture food, cultivate

kayitlar.explanation: In, from, or to a foreign country, especially one across the sea.
kayitlar.note:
Adverb (adv) [cite: 339]
Örnek Kullanım: to come from overseas. [cite: 340]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Most of our food comes from overseas. [cite: 340]
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He works overseas.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We import many goods from overseas.
kayitlar.synonyms: abroad, internationally, in another country, foreign

kayitlar.explanation: Relating to or characteristic of a town or city.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj)
Zıt anlamlısı: rural. [cite: 341]
Örnek Kullanım: urban agriculture / area / life. [cite: 343]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Urban agriculture is becoming more popular.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Traffic congestion is a common urban problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I prefer urban life to rural life.

kayitlar.explanation: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj)
Zıt anlamlısı: urban. [cite: 341]
Örnek Kullanım: rural agriculture / area / life. [cite: 343]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I grew up in a quiet rural area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Rural life is much slower than urban life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government is trying to improve rural agriculture.

kayitlar.explanation: The science or practice of farming, including cultivating soil and raising animals.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Agriculture is a very important industry in this country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Urban agriculture means growing food in cities. [cite: 343]
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Technology has changed modern agriculture.

kayitlar.explanation: The activity or business of growing crops and raising livestock.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) [cite: 344]
Örnek Kullanım: city / organic farming. [cite: 345]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: City farming is a new trend.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Organic farming is better for the environment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His family has been in farming for generations.
kayitlar.synonyms: agriculture, cultivation, growing crops, livestock management

kayitlar.explanation: To achieve a desired aim or result in a particular area.
kayitlar.note:
Verb Phrase (v phr)
Kullanım: to succeed in something. [cite: 347]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She succeeded in her career at a young age.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He finally succeeded in passing the exam.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: To succeed in life, you need to work hard.
kayitlar.synonyms: achieve, accomplish, be successful at, manage to, do well in

kayitlar.explanation: The accomplishment of an aim or purpose; a person or thing that achieves this.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) 
Örnek Kullanımlar:
to have/achieve success 
a great/big/huge success [cite: 350]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Her concert was a great success. [cite: 350]
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We are very happy with the success of the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She achieved great success in her career.

kayitlar.explanation: The ability of the mind to store and remember information, or a specific thing remembered.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) 
Örnek Kullanım: to have a (very) good memory. [cite: 352]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She had a very good memory for names. [cite: 352]
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I have a terrible memory for dates.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Oum Kalthoum had an amazing memory. [cite: 346, 351]

kayitlar.explanation: A natural aptitude or skill in a particular area.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) 
Örnek Kullanım: to have (a great/natural/real) talent. [cite: 354]
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He has a great talent for music.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She showed a natural talent for singing. [cite: 354]
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Oum Kalthoum was a singer with a great talent. [cite: 346, 353]
kayitlar.synonyms: skill, ability, gift, aptitude, natural ability

kayitlar.explanation: The process by which living things receive the food necessary for them to grow and be healthy.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
İlgili kelime: nutritionist (n) - beslenme uzmanı.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Nutrition information is now provided on the back of most food products.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Good nutrition is essential for growing children.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is studying nutrition at university.
kayitlar.synonyms: diet, nourishment, feeding, sustenance, food intake

kayitlar.explanation: To do something that involves physical or mental effort.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to work as a waiter/waitress.
İlgili kelime: worker (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The whole team is currently working on the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He worked as a teacher for over 20 years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I can't work when I'm tired.

kayitlar.explanation: To have information about something/somebody as a result of experience.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to be known for/as + noun / that sentence.
İlgili kelime: knowledge (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We know from experience that turning a hobby into a business is not easy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is widely known that CFCs can damage the ozone layer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Do you know how to solve this problem?
kayitlar.synonyms: understand, be aware of, be familiar with, recognize, comprehend
kayitlar.antonyms: be ignorant of, be unaware of, misunderstand

kayitlar.explanation: Pressure because of problems in somebody’s life or having too much to do.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was feeling very stressed and tired.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He left the job because it was really stressful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Exams are a major cause of stress for many students.

kayitlar.explanation: To keep thinking about unpleasant things that might happen or about problems that you have.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to be worried about something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Don’t worry! She can take care of herself.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Doctors are worried about the possible spread of the disease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I worry about my exams all the time.

kayitlar.explanation: To be in charge of a business, campaign, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb Phrase (v phr).
'run one's own business' şeklinde de kullanılır.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He has good experience in running a business.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She runs her own company from home.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It's very stressful to run a large company.

kayitlar.explanation: To search for something.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb (phr v).
Kullanım: look for something / a job.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: After losing hers, she needed to look for another job during the time of recession.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I am looking for my keys.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What are you looking for?
kayitlar.synonyms: search for, seek, hunt for, try to find

kayitlar.explanation: To rest especially after work or effort.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
İlgili kelimeler: relaxation (n), relaxing (adj), relaxed (adj).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She finished her lunch and then relaxed in the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We spent a relaxing evening with friends.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She looked completely relaxed.
kayitlar.synonyms: unwind, rest, calm down, take it easy, de-stress

kayitlar.explanation: Always telling the truth, and never stealing or cheating.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Zıt anlamlısı: dishonest.
Kullanım: to be/look/seem honest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They were honest, hard-working people.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: To be honest, I don't think I can finish this today.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need an honest opinion.

kayitlar.explanation: Not telling the truth; likely to steal, cheat, or lie.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was a dishonest man.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is dishonest to cheat on exams.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She was fired for dishonest behavior.

kayitlar.explanation: To prevent something bad from happening.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: avoid accidents / making eye contact.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We must find a way to avoid similar problems in the future.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I try to avoid driving during rush hour.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He avoided answering my question.
kayitlar.synonyms: evade, escape, steer clear of, dodge, shun

kayitlar.explanation: To look at somebody in the eye for a certain time.
kayitlar.note:
Verb Phrase (v phr).
'establish eye contact' şeklinde de kullanılır.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Making eye contact with the listeners helps attract more attention.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was too shy to make eye contact with her.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The lawyer made eye contact with the jury.
kayitlar.synonyms: look someone in the eye, maintain eye contact, look directly at

kayitlar.explanation: To do something with a machine, a method, an object, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to be used as…
İlgili kelime: the use of something… in ….
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Have you ever used this software before?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They started a campaign to encourage wider use of public transport.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The tennis court is sometimes used as a car park.
kayitlar.synonyms: employ, utilize, apply, make use of, operate

kayitlar.explanation: Knowing or realizing something.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective Phrase (adj phr).
'become aware of' şeklinde de kullanılır.
İlgili kelime: awareness (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was well aware of the problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She became aware that someone was watching her.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Are you aware of the risks?
kayitlar.antonyms: be ignorant of, be unaware of, overlook

kayitlar.explanation: To show or make known a feeling, an opinion, etc. by words, looks or actions.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
İlgili kelime: facial expression (n phr).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: By improving your nonverbal communication, you can express yourself better.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He expressed his concerns about the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Words cannot express how happy I am.

kayitlar.explanation: To share or exchange information, news, ideas, feelings, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: communicate with somebody.
İlgili kelime: communication (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They successfully communicated with each other in sign language.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to communicate our ideas more clearly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How do bees communicate?

kayitlar.explanation: To get or accept something that is sent or given to you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She received many messages of support.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Did you receive the email I sent you?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He received a prize for his work.
kayitlar.synonyms: get, obtain, accept, take in, be given

kayitlar.explanation: To make somebody unable to think clearly or understand something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: These two different sets of statistics will confuse the public.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The instructions were confusing, so everybody got confused.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Don't confuse me with your technical terms.
kayitlar.synonyms: bewilder, puzzle, mix up, perplex, disorient

kayitlar.explanation: To have the belief that somebody/something is good, sincere, honest, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Talking openly with your team helps to build trust.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I trust his judgment completely.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You can't trust him with your money.
kayitlar.synonyms: rely on, believe in, depend on, have faith in, count on

kayitlar.explanation: To have a very good opinion of somebody/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I respect Jack's opinion on most subjects.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She was a much loved and highly respected teacher.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You must respect your parents.

kayitlar.explanation: To rely on somebody/something and be able to trust them.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Nonverbal communication depends on your full focus on the moment-to-moment experience.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You can depend on me, I will be there.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The project's success depends on everyone working together.
kayitlar.synonyms: rely on, count on, be dependent on, hinge on
kayitlar.antonyms: be independent, not need, do without

kayitlar.explanation: To show or be a sign of the nature of something or of somebody’s attitude or feeling.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His behavior reflects his bad attitude.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The statistics reflect a change in people's habits.
kayitlar.synonyms: think about, consider, ponder, show, represent

kayitlar.explanation: More important, powerful or easy to notice than other things.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The dominant color in the painting is blue.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He has a very dominant personality.

kayitlar.explanation: Something that can be eaten; eatable.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: an edible organism / plant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is a beautiful and an edible organism.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This is a plant with edible leaves, so you can eat it.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Are these mushrooms edible or poisonous?
kayitlar.synonyms: safe to eat, eatable, consumable, fit for consumption

kayitlar.explanation: Most of the people or things in a group.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: a/the majority (of students / employees).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They can be free-floating, but the majority hold on to a hard surface.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A majority of the voters support the policy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The majority of people here are students.
kayitlar.synonyms: most, greater part, bulk, larger portion, mass

kayitlar.explanation: The distance from the surface/top to the bottom of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They can be found to depths of about 100 feet (30 meters).
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The boat sank to a depth of several hundred feet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is the depth of the pool?

kayitlar.explanation: Not deep; having a little depth.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: The shallow region of the ocean/sea/lake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The shallow end of the pool is for children who cannot swim.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The river is very shallow here.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We can walk across the stream; it's quite shallow.

kayitlar.explanation: Not including; but not.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The stores will be open daily except Sundays.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Everyone was at the party except for Sally.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I like all fruits except bananas.
kayitlar.synonyms: apart from, other than, excluding, with the exception of
kayitlar.antonyms: including, together with, as well as

kayitlar.explanation: To be in something or in a particular place; to be existing in something.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: to be present in something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Carrageenan is also present in toothpaste.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Oxygen and nitrogen are the two important gases that are present in the Earth’s atmosphere.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Were you present at the meeting yesterday?

kayitlar.explanation: Of greatest importance; the most important.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There are three main groups of seaweeds.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: What is the main idea of this text?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: My main concern is your safety.

kayitlar.explanation: Related to or found in the sea.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The red algae contains more marine species than the brown algae.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is studying marine biology.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Pollution is a serious threat to marine life.

kayitlar.explanation: (When used for things) not moving or slightly moving.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: At depths such as this, the water is much calmer and the algae are more delicate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The sea looks much calmer today.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Please stay calm and do not panic.

kayitlar.explanation: To have something inside or include something as a part.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The red algae contains more marine species than the brown algae.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This box contains old photographs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Does this drink contain any sugar?

kayitlar.explanation: (Of food) not cooked.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: raw fish / meat / food.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You can add it raw to your salad.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Sushi is made with raw fish.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is not safe to eat raw eggs.

kayitlar.explanation: The space between two lines or surfaces at the point at which they touch each other.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: at an angle, from all angles.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A boomerang must be thrown almost vertically at an angle of 50 degrees.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: In any triangle, the longest side is opposite the largest angle.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The photo was taken from a strange angle.

kayitlar.explanation: To join or be joined with something else.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to connect something to something.
İlgili kelimeler: connected (adj), connection (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The boomerang looks like two curved wings connected together.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Can I connect my printer to your computer?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The two towns are connected by a bridge.

kayitlar.explanation: An object or machine which has been invented for a particular purpose.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: useful / complex / simple device.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The boomerang is a simple device, but it relies on complex aerodynamics.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Rescuers used a special device for finding people who were trapped.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A smartphone is a very useful device.

kayitlar.explanation: Point or way in which people or things are dissimilar.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: the difference between A and B, to make a difference.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The difference in pressure causes lift.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Exercise can make a big difference to your state of health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What's the difference between an ape and a monkey?

kayitlar.explanation: The result of a particular influence.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to have a negative / positive / long-term effect on somebody/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The spin has two effects on the boomerang as it travels through the air.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I tried taking tablets for the headache but they didn't have any effect.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The new law had a positive effect on the economy.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who hates or opposes another person and tries to harm them.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to attack / kill the enemy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The killer-stick could fly very far to strike and kill an animal or enemy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: When these former friends quarreled over money, they became enemies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He has many enemies in the government.

kayitlar.explanation: To be positioned with the face or front towards.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to face windows / the door / the screen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A boomerang must be thrown facing the wind.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Their houses face each other across the street.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Our hotel room faces the sea.
kayitlar.synonyms: confront, deal with, encounter, address, tackle

kayitlar.explanation: To leave or escape from a person or place, often when it is difficult to do this.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb (phr v).
Kullanım: to get away from something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Thinking that it was a hawk, they would fly down to get away.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I'll get away from work as soon as I can.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The thief got away from the police.
kayitlar.synonyms: escape, flee, leave, break free, take a holiday

kayitlar.explanation: A person born in a specified place or associated with a place by birth.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: native of a place.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The real weapon used by Aborigines, Australian natives, was the killer-stick.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The natives of Africa live in tribes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is a native of New York.
kayitlar.synonyms: local, indigenous, original, natural, born in

kayitlar.explanation: To come back or go back to a previous place.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to return to something / somewhere.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He returned to America in the late autumn.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: When did you return from your trip?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She returned the book to the library.
kayitlar.synonyms: come back, go back, give back, restore, reappear

kayitlar.explanation: Uncontrolled, violent or extreme.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: wild animals / plants/ nature.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He would make the sound of a hawk (a kind of wild bird).
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We picked some wild strawberries in the forest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Lions are wild animals.

kayitlar.explanation: The things that are contained in something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She hadn't read the letter and so didn’t know about its contents.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The content of the course was very useful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He emptied the contents of the bag onto the table.
kayitlar.synonyms: satisfied, happy, at ease, pleased, fulfilled

kayitlar.explanation: That can be trusted, dependable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need a reliable car for our trip.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is a very reliable employee.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This website is not a reliable source of information.

kayitlar.explanation: Not able to be trusted or depended on.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The weather forecast is often unreliable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He's completely unreliable; he never does what he says he will.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The car is old and unreliable.

kayitlar.explanation: Violent behaviour that is intended to hurt or kill somebody.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
İlgili kelime: violent (adj).
Kullanım: witnessing violent behaviour, screen violence, exposure to violence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Police do not think this killing was a random act of violence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is too much violence on television.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Exposure to violence can affect children.

kayitlar.explanation: The condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to be addicted to something.
İlgili kelimeler: addict (n), addictive (adj).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is now fighting his addiction to alcohol.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She has an addiction to social media.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Gambling addiction can destroy families.

kayitlar.explanation: To make somebody want to create something, especially in art, literature or music.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: These inspiring entrepreneur stories show what young people can build.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His speech inspired us to try again.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The beautiful scenery inspired the artist.

kayitlar.explanation: To let somebody do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: allow somebody to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His parents won't allow him to stay out late.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Smoking is not allowed in this building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Please allow me to finish my sentence.

kayitlar.explanation: Lack of success in doing or achieving something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to fail something/a test, to fail to do something.
Zıt anlamlısı: to pass, to succeed.
İlgili kelime: failure (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The success or failure of the plan depends on your motivation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He failed his driving test.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She failed to arrive on time.
kayitlar.synonyms: be unsuccessful, not succeed, fall short, miss

kayitlar.explanation: To arrive at a particular point or stage of something after a period of time.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to reach something / success / goals / one’s full potential.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Learning from failures helps you reach your full potential.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We finally reached the top of the mountain.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company has reached its sales goals.
kayitlar.synonyms: achieve, attain, get to, arrive at, contact
kayitlar.antonyms: miss, fail to reach, fall short of

kayitlar.explanation: To give somebody support, courage or hope.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to encourage somebody to do something.
Zıt anlamlısı: to discourage.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Learners can feel very discouraged by low grades and stop trying.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: My parents always encouraged me to study hard.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We encourage students to join sports clubs.

kayitlar.explanation: To try to prevent something or to prevent someone from doing something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to discourage somebody from doing something.
Zıt anlamlısı: to encourage.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Learners can feel very discouraged by low grades.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Don't let this failure discourage you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The bad weather discouraged people from coming.
kayitlar.synonyms: deter, dishearten, put off, inhibit, dissuade

kayitlar.explanation: The process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty; the state of being dirty.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to cause environmental pollution.
İlgili kelime: pollute (v).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is a campaign to reduce atmospheric pollution.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need to find solutions to plastic pollution.

kayitlar.explanation: A belief, principle or way of acting which people in a particular society or group have continued to follow for a long time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: According to the tradition, he will come to their house to share the dinner.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Giving out sweets to children during Halloween is a tradition in the United States.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is a tradition in our family to eat fish on Fridays.

kayitlar.explanation: To put something with something else to increase the amount or number.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to add something to something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They think of that person’s favorite food and add those to the offering.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Do you want to add your name to the list?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Add more salt to the soup.
kayitlar.synonyms: include, put in, insert, supplement, combine

kayitlar.explanation: To decide what you want from two or more things or possibilities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: If they can’t remember, they choose typical Mexican food.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You have to choose between these two options.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She chose the blue dress.
kayitlar.synonyms: select, pick, decide on, opt for, prefer

kayitlar.explanation: To divide food, money, goods, etc. and give part of it to someone else.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to share something with somebody.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He will come to their house to share the dinner with them.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I shared my sandwich with my friend.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They share the cost of rent.
kayitlar.synonyms: give, distribute, divide, pass around, contribute

kayitlar.explanation: To help someone or something to move in a particular direction.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: To guide the person, they light some candles.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The teacher guided the students through the experiment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He guided me to the correct office.

kayitlar.explanation: To welcome someone with particular words or a particular action.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: People also go to the graveyards to greet and visit their loved ones.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He greeted me with a warm smile.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She greeted all the guests at the door.
kayitlar.synonyms: welcome, say hello, acknowledge, meet, receive

kayitlar.explanation: Being the only existing one of its type or, more generally, unusual or special in some way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This holiday in Mexico is unique in the world.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Each person's genetic code (DNA) is unique.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has a unique style of painting.

kayitlar.explanation: To continue to be in the same state or condition.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: remain silent / the same.
İlgili kelime: remaining (adj).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: As the kids remained silent, the class was very quiet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Mix in half the butter and keep the remaining half for later.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Please remain seated until the plane stops.

kayitlar.explanation: To go or travel along or through a place.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He passed along the corridor to a small room at the back of the building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We passed through several small villages.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A car passed me on the highway.
kayitlar.synonyms: go by, move past, succeed, transfer, exceed

kayitlar.explanation: The form that something has (round, square, etc.).
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: in shape, in the shape of something.
İlgili kelime: shaped (adj).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Our table is oval in shape.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A comet travels around the sun in an oval-shaped path.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She made a heart-shaped cake.

kayitlar.explanation: To change or be different from one occasion or item to another.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to vary from sth/sb to sth/sb / from place to place.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The time it takes can vary from 7 years to millions of years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Test scores vary from school to school.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Prices vary depending on the season.
kayitlar.antonyms: stay the same, remain constant, be uniform

kayitlar.explanation: To (make something) become larger in amount or size.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to increase in size / number / value.
Zıt anlamlısı: decrease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The velocity of a comet increases when it is near the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The number of employees increases during the summer months.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The population has increased by 5%.
kayitlar.synonyms: grow, rise, expand, add to, raise

kayitlar.explanation: To become less, or to make something become less.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to decrease in size / number / value, to decrease by 10%.
Zıt anlamlısı: increase.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The velocity of a comet decreases at the outer orbit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The country's total imports decreased by 6% in 2009.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The price of oil has decreased.

kayitlar.explanation: To go somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to disappear entirely / suddenly, to disappear from sight.
Zıt anlamlısı: appear.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: In the end it disappears completely.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: These flowers are disappearing from our fields and woods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
kayitlar.synonyms: vanish, fade, evaporate, go away, die out

kayitlar.explanation: Able to be seen.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: visible to something / to the naked eye, highly / clearly / barely visible.
Zıt anlamlısı: invisible.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A comet is only visible when it is near the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many stars become highly visible outside cities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The mountains were visible in the distance.

kayitlar.explanation: Not able to be seen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He felt like he was invisible in the crowd.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The house was invisible in the fog.

kayitlar.explanation: To be, to be real, or to appear in the real world.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: actually / really exist, continue to exist.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: In the end it disappears completely; that is, it doesn’t exist anymore.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I don't think ghosts exist.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This problem has existed for a long time.
kayitlar.synonyms: be, live, occur, be present, be found
kayitlar.antonyms: not exist, cease to be, disappear, vanish

kayitlar.explanation: To hit something hard, making a loud noise and often causing damage.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to crash something, to crash into something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Some of the sun grazers crash into the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: While driving, he fell asleep and crashed into a tree.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The plane crashed shortly after takeoff.
kayitlar.synonyms: collide, smash, hit, break down, collapse

kayitlar.explanation: To touch or move into something or someone quickly and with force.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to hit somebody on his / her leg / head.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Some others don't hit the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Some small asteroids hit the Earth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He hit the ball over the fence.
kayitlar.synonyms: strike, knock, collide with, impact, reach

kayitlar.explanation: The thing which is being discussed, considered or studied.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: a simple / complex subject, to talk about / discuss a subject.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Astronomy is one of physics’ most fascinating subjects.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She wrote many books on the subject of family relationships.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is your favorite subject in school?

kayitlar.explanation: Relating to the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Our solar system consists of the sun, nine planets, and comets.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We are installing solar panels on our roof.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A solar eclipse is a beautiful event.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: partly / fully / briefly explain something (to somebody).
İlgili kelime: explanation (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Astronomy also tries to explain the formation of the universe.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The teacher explained the rules to the children.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Can you explain why you were late?
kayitlar.synonyms: describe, clarify, outline, account for, define

kayitlar.explanation: The way something is naturally made or the way it has been arranged.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Astronomy also tries to explain the formation of the universe.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: These days a lot of people are complaining about the formation of stones in their kidneys.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We studied the rock formations in the canyon.

kayitlar.explanation: (Of a substance) containing a lot of matter in a small space.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The universe was very small and dense.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Because the fog was so dense, we couldn’t see the road.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is a very dense forest.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something happen, usually something bad.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to cause damage / problems, to cause sb/sth to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Something unknown caused the universe to explode 15 billion years ago.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The storm caused widespread damage.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Smoking can cause cancer.

kayitlar.explanation: To (cause to) break up into pieces violently.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: a bomb explodes.
İlgili kelime: explosion (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Something unknown caused the universe to explode.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A bomb exploded at one of London's busiest railway stations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The fire was caused by a gas explosion.
kayitlar.synonyms: burst, blow up, detonate, erupt, blast

kayitlar.explanation: To make something new, especially to invent something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to create something (from something).
İlgili kelime: creation (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This explosion created matter, energy and also space and time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The government is to provide more money for job creation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She created a beautiful painting.

kayitlar.explanation: To increase in size, number or importance, or to make something increase in this way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The universe became very hot and it began to expand.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The water froze inside the pipe and caused it to expand and burst.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company is planning to expand its operations.

kayitlar.explanation: To come together and make, form something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: These atoms made up the stars and the galaxies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Women make up 50% of the workforce.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This team is made up of players from all over the country.

kayitlar.explanation: To suddenly fall down, fail, or stop existing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The universe may turn around and collapse in another big explosion.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The building collapsed during the earthquake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She collapsed from exhaustion.
kayitlar.synonyms: fall, break down, fail, crash, crumble

kayitlar.explanation: To experience physical or mental pain.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to suffer from an illness / depression.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Every year, millions of people suffer from foodborne illnesses.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He suffers from migraine headaches.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company suffered huge losses last year.
kayitlar.synonyms: endure, bear, experience, undergo, go through

kayitlar.explanation: The state of being safe and protected from danger or harm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: If you know the basics of food safety facts, this will help you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The safety of the passengers is our main priority.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was worried about the safety of his children.

kayitlar.explanation: A disease of the body or mind, or the condition of being ill.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to cause/have/prevent/suffer from an illness.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: These people do not even know it was food that caused their illness.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He died after a long illness.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She is suffering from a serious illness.

kayitlar.explanation: A person harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or a disaster.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: the victims of cancer/accident/earthquake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This will help you not to become victims of foodborne illnesses.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was the victim of a serious accident.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The victims of the flood need help.

kayitlar.explanation: A position on a scale of amount, quantity, extent, or quality.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: safe X dangerous / high X low / increasing / decreasing levels of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: If they warm up, bacteria may grow to dangerous levels.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her blood pressure has returned to its normal level.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is your level of English?

kayitlar.explanation: Very quickly and in a very short time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: If we transfer those bacteria to the food, they will rapidly grow there.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The human population is growing rapidly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The situation is changing rapidly.

kayitlar.explanation: Causing or likely to cause harm.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: harmful bacteria/products, to be harmful to something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Most of these bacteria are not harmful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Most human activities are harmful to the environment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Smoking is harmful to your health.

kayitlar.explanation: To eat or drink; to use.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Do not forget to wash fresh fruits before you consume them.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This car consumes a lot of fuel.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The average person consumes 2000 calories a day.
kayitlar.synonyms: eat, use, spend, take in, absorb

kayitlar.explanation: Increase or cause to increase greatly in number or quantity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The Salmonella begins to multiply rapidly at room temperature.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Bacteria multiply very quickly in warm conditions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What do you get if you multiply 6 by 10?

kayitlar.explanation: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists or cannot be used.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to completely destroy sth, to be destroyed by fire/a bomb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Even reheating the food cannot destroy the toxins of some bacteria.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The school was completely destroyed by fire.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The storm destroyed many houses.
kayitlar.synonyms: ruin, demolish, wreck, eliminate, wipe out

kayitlar.explanation: Something that happens as a result of a particular action or set of conditions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The consequences of foodborne illnesses are not worth the money you will save.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We should consider the long-term consequences before deciding.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He must face the consequences of his actions.

kayitlar.explanation: Any substance that plants or animals need in order to live and grow.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Nutrients are substances in food necessary for good health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Fish is a source of many nutrients, such as protein, vitamins and minerals.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This cereal is packed with vitamins and nutrients.

kayitlar.explanation: To take in or soak up (energy or liquid) by chemical or physical action.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to absorb something (into something).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The body breaks food into its nutrients and absorbs them into our bloodstream.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This drug is quickly absorbed into the bloodstream.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A sponge absorbs water.
kayitlar.synonyms: take in, soak up, assimilate, incorporate

kayitlar.explanation: The purpose that something has, or the job that somebody or something does.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There are more than 40 nutrients with specific functions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The function of the heart is to pump blood.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This new software has many useful functions.

kayitlar.explanation: A thing, place or activity that you get something from.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Carbohydrates are the body’s main source of energy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Beans are a very good source of protein.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The internet is a great source of information.
kayitlar.synonyms: origin, beginning, cause, supply, starting point

kayitlar.explanation: In such a manner as to achieve a desired result.
kayitlar.note:
Adverb (adv).
Kullanım: to use something effectively.
İlgili kelime: effective (adj).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Our bodies need carbohydrates to use fats effectively.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Children have to learn to communicate effectively.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The team worked together effectively.

kayitlar.explanation: Appropriately for the circumstances; suitably.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The brain can’t work properly without carbohydrates.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The brakes don't seem to work properly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You should always wash your hands properly before eating.

kayitlar.explanation: Completely; absolutely.
kayitlar.note:
Adverb (adv).
Kullanım: totally + adjective, totally agree with somebody.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many people think that fats are totally bad for you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I totally forgot about the meeting.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The situation is totally different now.

kayitlar.explanation: In fact, or really.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I didn't actually see her - I just heard her voice.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He looks young, but he's actually 50.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I thought he was joking, but he actually meant it.
kayitlar.synonyms: in fact, in reality, really, truly, as a matter of fact

kayitlar.explanation: Take or carry (people or goods) from one place to another.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to transport somebody / something (to somewhere).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Fats transport nutrients and they are part of some body cells.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Hundreds of buses transported people out of the city before the storm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The goods will be transported by ship.

kayitlar.explanation: To need something or make something necessary.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Three patients required operations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This job requires a lot of patience.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: All students are required to attend.
kayitlar.synonyms: need, demand, call for, necessitate, depend on

kayitlar.explanation: Existing in great quantities; abundant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Fish are plentiful in this river.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We have a plentiful supply of food.

kayitlar.explanation: To put something that is damaged or not working correctly back into good condition.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to repair a machine.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Protein builds and repairs the body cells.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He repaired the roof after the storm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Can you repair my broken watch?

kayitlar.explanation: Necessary; needed.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: to be essential for somebody/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is also essential for growth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Water is essential for life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is essential to arrive on time.

kayitlar.explanation: A series of changes that happen naturally.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Vitamins are necessary for many different body processes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Learning a language is a long process.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Peace is a slow process.
kayitlar.synonyms: handle, treat, manage, deal with, carry out

kayitlar.explanation: To control something by making it work in a particular way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The body needs them in small amounts to regulate internal chemical processes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A thermostat regulates the temperature.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government regulates the stock market.

kayitlar.explanation: To take the place of something or put in the place of something or someone else.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to replace somebody / something (with somebody/something else).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: One vitamin cannot replace another.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The factory replaced most of its workers with robots.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I need to replace the battery in my car.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of fighting against something that is attacking you.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: resistance to / against something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Vitamin C from vegetables and fruit increases our resistance to cold.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There's a lot of resistance to the new idea.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Some bacteria develop resistance to antibiotics.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something stay the same.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Calcium helps build and maintain strong bones and teeth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is important to maintain a healthy weight.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He maintained his innocence.

kayitlar.explanation: Used to show a choice of two things.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I'm going to buy either the blue one or the red one.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You can either take the bus or walk. It’s up to you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You can have either tea or coffee.

kayitlar.explanation: Not equal; not of the same quantity, quality, value, rank, ability, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: People are unequal in their capacities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The teams were unequal in skill.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They received an unequal distribution of food.

kayitlar.explanation: Being the same in quantity, size, degree, or value.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: All people are equal before the law.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Divide the cake into six equal pieces.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Men and women should receive equal pay for equal work.

kayitlar.explanation: To increase, or move to cover a larger area or affect a larger number of people.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The smoke soon spread into all the rooms in the house.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The virus is spread by rats.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The fire spread very quickly.

kayitlar.explanation: To give up; withdraw from.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She had to abandon the research project when the grant money dried up.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The driver abandoned the car after the accident.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They were forced to abandon their homes.
kayitlar.synonyms: leave, desert, give up, forsake, quit

kayitlar.explanation: Often; frequently.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: These caterpillars are commonly found on nettles.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This word is not commonly used anymore.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is commonly known as 'flu' is a serious illness.

kayitlar.explanation: To an ever greater degree; more and more.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Marketers are increasingly using video to create emotional connections.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is becoming increasingly difficult to find a job.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She became increasingly anxious.
kayitlar.synonyms: more and more, progressively, growing, ever more

kayitlar.explanation: Far apart; far distant in space; situated at some distance away.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A fire in a remote mountain area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The farmhouse is remote from any other buildings.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They live in a remote village.

kayitlar.explanation: To often do a particular thing or be likely to do a particular thing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: July and August tend to be our busiest months.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: People tend to eat more in winter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He tends to be late on Mondays.
kayitlar.synonyms: be likely to, be inclined to, have a habit of, usually

kayitlar.explanation: To be likely to cause harm or damage to something or someone.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His knee problem is threatening his cycling career.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Pollution is threatening marine life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company threatened to close the factory.
kayitlar.synonyms: menace, intimidate, endanger, put at risk, warn

kayitlar.explanation: Something that has been designed or created for the first time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A lot of great inventions have come from America.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The invention of the computer changed the world.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is a very clever invention.

kayitlar.explanation: The fact of not having someone or something that you had before, or of having less of something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
