kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: in an effort to do something, to make an effort.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You need to make an effort to be more sociable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She put a lot of effort into her work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: In an effort to save money, they stopped eating out.

kayitlar.explanation: To save or keep money, time, etc. for a particular purpose.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb (phr v).
Kullanım: to set aside money/budget.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She tries to set aside some money every month.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I set aside an hour every day to exercise.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need to set aside a budget for this project.
kayitlar.synonyms: reserve, save, put away, allocate, keep

kayitlar.explanation: To continue to live or exist, especially after a difficult or dangerous event.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Only a few people survived the crash.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This plant cannot survive in cold weather.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He survived for six weeks on just water.
kayitlar.synonyms: endure, persist, live on, last, withstand

kayitlar.explanation: To prepare and use land for growing plants or crops.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The land around here has been cultivated for centuries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The Mayans cultivated corn.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They cultivate grapes for making wine.

kayitlar.explanation: Not fully developed or grown.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should not eat immature fruit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Immature corn is not good to eat.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is very immature for his age.

kayitlar.explanation: Fully grown or developed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should pick the fruit when it is mature.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She is very mature for her age.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This cheese needs time to mature.

kayitlar.explanation: To make things to be sold.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to produce a plant.
İlgili kelime: production (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The factory produces a range of electronic goods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This plant produces beautiful flowers.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Car production has decreased this year.

kayitlar.explanation: A set of different things of the same general type.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: a range of colours from white to red.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We offer a wide range of services.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Corn comes in a range of colors, from white to red.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This store sells a wide range of products.

kayitlar.explanation: Several different.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There are various ways to solve the problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Corn is used to make various foods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We met people from various countries.

kayitlar.explanation: To be the first person to find out something that was not known before.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to discover sth / a fact / that...
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Scientists have discovered a new species of monkey.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They discovered that corn was a very useful plant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Who discovered America?

kayitlar.explanation: To increase in size, number, strength or quality.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company has grown in the last few years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They grow their own vegetables.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This plant grows very quickly.

kayitlar.explanation: The line that divides two countries or areas.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: the border between two countries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We crossed the border into Spain.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The border between India and Pakistan is a sensitive area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He lives near the Canadian border.

kayitlar.explanation: Extremely important, because it will affect other things.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: to be/become/remain as crucial (for sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is crucial that we solve this problem immediately.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Education is crucial for a country's development.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is a crucial decision for the company.

kayitlar.explanation: Old-fashioned and therefore not as good or useful as something modern.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This information is out of date.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His clothes are very out of date.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This technology is already out of date.

kayitlar.explanation: To think about somebody/something in a particular way.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to view somebody/something as something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He views the situation with optimism.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Some people view arranged marriages as old-fashioned.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How do you view your future?

kayitlar.explanation: To happen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The accident occurred at 5 p.m.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Arranged marriages still occur in many countries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: These problems commonly occur in old houses.
kayitlar.synonyms: happen, take place, arise, emerge, come about

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with a town or city.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Pollution is a major problem in urban areas.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This tradition is more common in urban families.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I prefer urban life to life in the country.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with the countryside.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She lives in a small rural village.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The rural economy is based on agriculture.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I prefer the quiet rural life.

kayitlar.explanation: To order somebody not to do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to forbid somebody from doing something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Smoking is forbidden in this building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His parents forbid him from going to the party.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The law forbids the sale of alcohol to minors.

kayitlar.explanation: Having or including the most recent information.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: to keep somebody up-to-date on something, up-to-date data.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need to keep our records up-to-date.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This is the most up-to-date information available.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Please keep me up-to-date on this project.
kayitlar.antonyms: out of date, outdated, obsolete, old

kayitlar.explanation: To form a picture of somebody/something in your mind.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to visualize somebody/something // sb doing sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I can't visualize him as a father.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It's hard to visualize the size of the universe.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She tried to visualize herself winning the race.
kayitlar.synonyms: imagine, picture, see in the mind, envision, conceive
kayitlar.antonyms: ignore, fail to see, be unimaginative

kayitlar.explanation: The introduction of new things, ideas or ways of doing something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: major innovations // innovations in something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company is a leader in product innovation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The internet was a major innovation in communication.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need to encourage innovation in technology.
kayitlar.synonyms: new idea, invention, breakthrough, creativity, novelty

kayitlar.explanation: A service provided for the public, for example an electricity, water or gas supply.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need to pay the utility bills.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The internet was first seen as an information utility.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How much do you pay for utilities each month?

kayitlar.explanation: To make something easier to do or understand.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Can you simplify your explanation?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The internet greatly simplified access to information.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He tried to simplify the complex instructions.
kayitlar.synonyms: make easier, streamline, clarify, reduce complexity

kayitlar.explanation: Useful, easy or quick to do; not causing problems.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is very convenient to pay by credit card.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The new shopping mall is very convenient for me.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is the most convenient time for you to meet?

kayitlar.explanation: To tell somebody another person's name the first time that they meet.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to introduce something/somebody to somebody.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Let me introduce you to my boss.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company introduced a new product last year.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He introduced me to his friends.
kayitlar.synonyms: present, bring in, launch, begin, initiate

kayitlar.explanation: A principle, an idea or a fact that something is based on and that it grows from.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: (to form) the foundation of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Respect is the foundation of a good relationship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This idea formed the foundation of his theory.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They are laying the foundations for the new building.

kayitlar.explanation: The facts, signs or objects that make you believe that something is true.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) (Uncountable).
Kullanım: find/have (direct) evidence (to prove sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is no scientific evidence to support these claims.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The police are looking for evidence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Do you have any evidence to prove this?

kayitlar.explanation: To show that something is true or exists.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to (clearly) indicate that + sentence // something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Research indicates that a high-fat diet is bad for you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The study indicates a link between smoking and cancer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The red light indicates that the machine is on.
kayitlar.synonyms: show, suggest, point to, signal, demonstrate

kayitlar.explanation: To make something less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to reduce from sth to sth.
İlgili kelime: reduction (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need to reduce our spending.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company reduced the price from 100 to 80.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You should reduce your salt intake.

kayitlar.explanation: The amount of food, drink, etc. that you take into your body.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to maintain/control alcohol/drug/water intake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should reduce your daily intake of salt.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His alcohol intake is a problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is your average daily calorie intake?
kayitlar.synonyms: consumption, amount taken in, input, ingestion

kayitlar.explanation: To be very interested in something or eager to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is keen on playing tennis.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I'm not very keen on spicy food.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is keen on learning new things.
kayitlar.synonyms: enjoy, love, be enthusiastic about, be interested in

kayitlar.explanation: The bad feeling that you have when you are in danger or when a particular thing frightens you.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n) / Verb (v).
Kullanım: to greatly fear that + sentence, to have/feel a deep fear of sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He feared for the safety of his family.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She has a deep fear of spiders.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They feared that the enemy would attack.

kayitlar.explanation: That you can get, buy or find.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Tickets are available from the box office.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This spice is available in most grocery stores.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Is the manager available to talk?
kayitlar.synonyms: accessible, obtainable, free, on hand, ready

kayitlar.explanation: Not able to be used, bought, or found.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The book is currently unavailable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I'm sorry, the manager is unavailable right now.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This feature is unavailable in the free version.
kayitlar.synonyms: inaccessible, not available, occupied, out of reach

kayitlar.explanation: To make somebody do something that they do not want to do.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to force somebody to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was forced to resign.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They forced him to sign the contract.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Don't force me to do this.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of allowing somebody to do something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: permission to do something.
İlgili kelime: permit (v).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You need to get permission from your parents.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He asked for permission to leave early.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They entered the building without permission.

kayitlar.explanation: The information, understanding and skills that you gain through education or experience.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He has a wide knowledge of painting and music.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This book requires specialist knowledge.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A little knowledge can be a dangerous thing.

kayitlar.explanation: Belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We visited the ancient ruins in Rome.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is an expert on ancient history.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is an ancient tradition.

kayitlar.explanation: A connection between two or more people or things.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: a link between sth and sth / with sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is a strong link between smoking and cancer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Scientists are studying the link between diet and health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The link with ancient Greece is very clear.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who starts an organization, institution, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: the founder of a company/brand.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is the founder and managing director of the company.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She is one of the founders of the new party.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Bill Gates is the founder of Microsoft.

kayitlar.explanation: To be an abbreviation or a symbol of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: What does 'CPU' stand for?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The letters 'AI' stand for 'Artificial Intelligence'.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The color green often stands for nature.
kayitlar.synonyms: represent, symbolize, mean, advocate for, defend

kayitlar.explanation: To have a particular function or purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The box can serve as a table.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The building served as a hospital during the war.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This room serves as my office.
kayitlar.synonyms: act as, function as, be used as, operate as, play the role of

kayitlar.explanation: An important development or discovery.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to make a major/significant breakthrough in sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Scientists have made a major breakthrough in the treatment of cancer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This was a significant breakthrough in AI research.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We are hoping for a breakthrough in the negotiations.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who has come to live permanently in a country that is not their own.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: a land of immigrants / illegal immigrants.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many immigrants came to America in the 19th century.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: America is a land of immigrants.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There are many illegal immigrants working in the city.

kayitlar.explanation: To come and live permanently in a country after leaving your own country.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to immigrate to the USA from poor areas.
İlgili kelime: immigration (n).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His family immigrated to Canada.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many people immigrated to the USA from poor areas.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She is applying for an immigration visa.
kayitlar.synonyms: move to, settle in, migrate to, relocate

kayitlar.explanation: A person who has the legal right to belong to a particular country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is a French citizen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She applied for American citizenship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is your duty as a citizen to vote.

kayitlar.explanation: That cannot be predicted because it changes a lot or depends on too many different things.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: unpredictable economies/weather/result.
Zıt anlamlısı: predictable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The weather in this country is very unpredictable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The economy is unpredictable at the moment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His mood is very unpredictable.

kayitlar.explanation: That can be predicted; happening or behaving in a way that you expect.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The ending of the movie was very predictable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His reaction was completely predictable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The weather is more predictable in summer.

kayitlar.explanation: Causing worry and fear.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective (adj).
Kullanım: at an (extremely) alarming rate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The report revealed some alarming statistics.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The number of new cases is rising at an alarming rate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is an alarming development.

kayitlar.explanation: To be in a better position because of something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to benefit from something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many people will benefit from the new law.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I hope you benefit from this experience.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Who will benefit most from this decision?

kayitlar.explanation: Something that is done in advance in order to prevent problems or avoid danger.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: to take necessary precautions against something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should take precautions against fire.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They took the necessary precautions to avoid accidents.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: As a precaution, you should always lock your car.

kayitlar.explanation: Good enough for a particular purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We have not yet found a satisfactory solution to the problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her work is satisfactory, but not excellent.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The results of the test were satisfactory.
kayitlar.synonyms: adequate, acceptable, good enough, sufficient, passable

kayitlar.explanation: That must be obeyed exactly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is a very strict teacher.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company has strict rules against smoking.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is on a very strict diet.

kayitlar.explanation: A style of cooking.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (n).
Kullanım: an excellent local cuisine.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I love Italian cuisine.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The hotel is famous for its excellent local cuisine.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Have you ever tried Thai cuisine?
kayitlar.synonyms: food, cooking style, culinary tradition, gastronomy

kayitlar.explanation: Clearly different or of a different kind.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The two languages are quite distinct from each other.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a distinct smell of gas in here.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has a very distinct style of writing.

kayitlar.explanation: To tell somebody that something is good or useful.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to recommend an idea/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Can you recommend a good restaurant?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I recommend this book to anyone interested in history.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The doctor recommended that I get more rest.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of protecting somebody/something; the state of being protected.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This cream gives good protection against the sun.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A helmet provides protection for your head.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Vitamins give you protection from diseases.

kayitlar.explanation: To stop something from happening or to stop somebody from doing something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to prevent heart diseases.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The police tried to prevent him from leaving.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Eating healthy food can help prevent heart disease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We must prevent this from happening again.

kayitlar.explanation: To give something to somebody or make it available for them to use.
kayitlar.note:
Verb (v).
Kullanım: to provide sth to people, to provide people with sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company provides free health insurance to its employees.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We provide our clients with the best service.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Fish provides many essential nutrients.

kayitlar.explanation: Used to show that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Don and Sue loved each other throughout their entire lives.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: My friends and I help each other with homework.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They looked at each other and smiled.

kayitlar.explanation: To seem; to have a particular appearance.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The garden looks great!
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You look tired. Are you okay?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: That cake looks delicious.

kayitlar.explanation: To seem to have a particular quality when heard.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The plan sounds feasible!
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: That sounds like a great idea.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Your voice sounds strange. Do you have a cold?

kayitlar.explanation: To have a particular physical or emotional quality.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The house feels warm and cosy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It feels great to be back home.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This fabric feels very soft.

kayitlar.explanation: To have a particular flavor.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Home-made pizza tastes more delicious than others.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This soup tastes strange.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The apple tasted sweet.

kayitlar.explanation: To become different; to make somebody/something different.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: Something alters / to alter something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Prices did not alter significantly during 2024.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He had to alter his plans to cope with the new situation.

kayitlar.explanation: To come near to somebody/something in distance or time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Winter is approaching.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to adopt a new approach to the problem.

kayitlar.explanation: The state of being kept in a place and not being allowed to leave.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to hold/keep somebody/an animal in captivity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The animals were born in captivity.

kayitlar.explanation: To fasten or join one thing to another.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to attach something (to something).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Please attach a recent photograph to your application form.

kayitlar.explanation: To continue to live or exist, especially after a difficult or dangerous event.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to survive a plane crash/an accident/in very cold conditions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Few people have survived in these freezing temperatures.
kayitlar.synonyms: endure, persist, withstand, live on, outlast

kayitlar.explanation: To form a particular thing, amount, or number as a whole.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb.
Kullanım: to make up a large proportion/two-thirds, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Women make up 56% of the student population.

kayitlar.explanation: All the people who live in a particular area, country, etc. when talked about as a group.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The local community was shocked by the news.

kayitlar.explanation: To discover the facts about something; to calculate something exactly.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to determine something / that + sentence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: An inquiry was set up to determine the cause of the accident.

kayitlar.explanation: The way that something is shared or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: personal/the distribution of wealth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.

kayitlar.explanation: A situation in which a plant, an animal, a way of life, etc. stops existing.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to be in danger of extinction.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many species of plants and animals are in danger of extinction.

kayitlar.explanation: Different from what is usual or normal.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It's unusual for the trees to flower so early.

kayitlar.explanation: (Of a type of animal, plant, etc.) no longer in existence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.

kayitlar.explanation: Not having much distance between the top or surface and the bottom.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: shallow water/end (of the swimming pool).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The stream is quite shallow, so we can walk across it.

kayitlar.explanation: To say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to threaten to do something / threaten somebody with something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The hijackers threatened to kill one passenger every hour.

kayitlar.explanation: The movement of water in the sea or a river; the movement of air.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to swim against the current.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was swept out to sea by the strong current.

kayitlar.explanation: A statement in which you tell somebody that you will punish or harm them.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Pollution poses a serious threat to the environment.

kayitlar.explanation: A way of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a solution (to something), to find a solution.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is no simple solution to this problem.

kayitlar.explanation: To have to deal with a difficult situation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company is facing a financial crisis.
kayitlar.synonyms: confront, address, encounter, deal with, tackle

kayitlar.explanation: The outside or top layer of something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the surface of something, the earth's/moon's surface.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The surface of the lake was very calm.

kayitlar.explanation: An action or a service that helps to cause or improve something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to make a contribution to something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He made a significant contribution to the success of the project.

kayitlar.explanation: To make it possible for somebody/something to do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to enable somebody to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This new software will enable us to work more efficiently.

kayitlar.explanation: To give something, especially money or goods, to help achieve or provide something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.

kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She works as a teacher.
kayitlar.synonyms: since, because, while, when, in the role of

kayitlar.explanation: Earlier; before something else happens or is done.

kayitlar.synonyms: in advance, previously, ahead of time, earlier, prior

kayitlar.explanation: To be told about somebody/something.

kayitlar.synonyms: learn of, be told about, know about, become aware of

kayitlar.explanation: Used to emphasize something that is surprising.

kayitlar.synonyms: also, too, additionally, as well, in spite of that

kayitlar.explanation: To have an appearance that is similar to somebody/something.

Verb Phrase.

kayitlar.synonyms: resemble, appear to be, seem, take after, be similar to
kayitlar.antonyms: differ from, contrast with, be unlike

kayitlar.explanation: To gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to acquire a skill/knowledge/a language.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It takes many years to acquire a new language.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He has acquired a reputation for being a very difficult person to work with.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has acquired a lot of experience in the field of technology during her internship.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of getting something, especially knowledge, a skill, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company's latest acquisition is a small software firm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Language acquisition starts at a very young age for most children.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The acquisition of new skills is vital for career progression.

kayitlar.explanation: To think about a problem or a situation and decide how you are going to deal with it.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to address a gap/issue/problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government must address the problem of unemployment immediately.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to address these issues before they get out of control.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His speech failed to address the concerns of the local people.

kayitlar.explanation: A quality or feature of somebody/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Patience is an essential attribute for a good teacher.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The panel discussed the key attributes required for the managerial position.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Confidence is a remarkable attribute that helps in public speaking.

kayitlar.explanation: A problem, rule or situation that prevents somebody from doing something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a barrier to growth/success; to create/reduce/overcome/remove a barrier.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Language can be a major barrier to communication in a foreign country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The team worked hard to overcome the technical barriers to the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Lack of funding is the main barrier to the development of the new vaccine.

kayitlar.explanation: An opinion that all members of a group agree with.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: consensus on/about something; reach a consensus.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The committee has finally reached a consensus on the new budget.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is no consensus among scientists about the cause of the disease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is difficult to reach a consensus when everyone has such different opinions.

kayitlar.explanation: To show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to demonstrate an ability/skill/knowledge.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The test results demonstrate the effectiveness of the new drug.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He has demonstrated a remarkable ability to lead the team.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You need to demonstrate your skills during the interview process.

kayitlar.explanation: A belief that something will happen because it is likely.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: high/low expectation of sth/sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The holiday lived up to all our expectations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a general expectation that the economy will improve.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Parents often have high expectations of their children.

kayitlar.explanation: To think or believe that something will happen.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to expect sb to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I expect to be back on Sunday.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We are expecting a large crowd at the concert tonight.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Don't expect him to help you with your homework.

kayitlar.explanation: To put money, effort, time, etc. into something to make a profit or get an advantage.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to invest in workforce/people/company; to invest money/time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company plans to invest heavily in new technology.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You should invest your time in learning new skills.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He invested all his savings in a local business.
kayitlar.synonyms: spend, put money into, fund, commit

kayitlar.explanation: The act of investing money in something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government is encouraging foreign investment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A good education is the best investment for your future.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They made a huge investment in the new factory.

kayitlar.explanation: A word or phrase that is used to describe somebody/something in a very simple way.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: attach a label to sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The product has a label showing the ingredients.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You shouldn't attach a negative label to someone you don't know.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was labelled as a troublemaker by his teachers.

kayitlar.explanation: To make somebody do something by giving them good reasons.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to persuade sb to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I managed to persuade him to come to the party.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is difficult to persuade people to change their habits.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She tried to persuade her parents to let her travel.

kayitlar.explanation: Exactly; accurately.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: That is precisely what I meant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The meeting will start precisely at nine o'clock.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It's hard to know precisely how many people were there.

kayitlar.explanation: No longer needed; without a job because there is no more work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Seventy workers were made redundant when the factory closed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The old system is now redundant due to the new software.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was concerned about being made redundant.

kayitlar.explanation: Hesitating before doing something because you do not want to do it.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be reluctant to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She was reluctant to admit she was wrong.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many people are reluctant to talk about their problems.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was reluctant to leave his home town.

kayitlar.explanation: The feeling of being unwilling to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I understand your reluctance to get involved.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His reluctance to help was very disappointing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is a growing reluctance among youth to join the military.

kayitlar.explanation: A way of dealing with a problem or making a bad situation better.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a remedy for/to a problem/illness.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The best remedy for a cold is rest and plenty of fluids.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Congress is searching for a remedy to the economic crisis.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is no easy remedy for the city's traffic problems.

kayitlar.explanation: A situation where there is not enough of something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a shortage of skilled labor/food/water.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is a serious shortage of clean water in the region.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The food shortage was caused by the long drought.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Many hospitals are facing a shortage of nurses.

kayitlar.explanation: A person or thing that you use instead of the one that you usually have.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a substitute for sb/sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The coach put in a substitute for the injured player.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Margarine is often used as a substitute for butter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is no substitute for hard work.

kayitlar.explanation: An amount of something that is provided or available to be used.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: plentiful/adequate supply; gas/electricity/water supply.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The city's water supply is running low.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We have a plentiful supply of food for the winter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The demand for electricity exceeds the supply during summer.

kayitlar.explanation: Not available in large enough amounts.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Fresh vegetables are in short supply during the winter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Qualified teachers are in short supply in rural areas.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: In the desert, water is always in short supply.

kayitlar.explanation: Done, made or given willingly, without being forced or paid.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: voluntary work/service; voluntary organization.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She does voluntary work at the local hospital.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The organization relies on voluntary contributions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Attendance at the meeting is purely voluntary.

kayitlar.explanation: A strong feeling in favour of or against one group of people unfairly.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: bias towards/against; unconscious bias.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The report showed a clear bias against the opposition.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Unconscious bias can affect hiring decisions in big companies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We must try to avoid bias in our research.

kayitlar.explanation: To say or believe that something is the result of a particular thing.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to attribute sth to sb/sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The success of the project was attributed to hard work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She attributes her health to a strict vegetarian diet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The error was attributed to a technical fault.
kayitlar.synonyms: credit to, assign to, put down to, ascribe to

kayitlar.explanation: To prevent somebody from having or enjoying something important.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to deprive somebody of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You cannot deprive a child of proper education.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The long working hours deprive him of sleep.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The new law would deprive citizens of their basic rights.
kayitlar.synonyms: deny, strip, rob, take away from

kayitlar.explanation: To remove or get rid of something completely.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to eliminate sth (from sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need to eliminate all possible sources of error.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The goal is to eliminate poverty in the region.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Several teams were eliminated from the competition.
kayitlar.synonyms: remove, eradicate, get rid of, abolish

kayitlar.explanation: To experience something, especially something unpleasant or difficult.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We encountered many difficulties during the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I encountered an old friend in the street.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The pilot encountered a problem with the engine.

kayitlar.explanation: To make an action or a process possible or easier.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new airport will facilitate tourism in the area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Structured lessons facilitate the learning process.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The computer program is designed to facilitate data entry.

kayitlar.explanation: To get involved in a situation where you are not wanted or needed.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to interfere with sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Don't interfere in things that don't concern you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: High levels of stress can interfere with your sleep.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I don't want to interfere with your plans.

kayitlar.explanation: That cannot be seen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He felt as if he were invisible to the crowd.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The plane is invisible to radar.

kayitlar.explanation: To move somebody to a higher rank; to help something happen or develop.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to be/get promoted to sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She was promoted to senior manager last month.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The organization works to promote human rights.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Milk is promoted as a healthy drink for children.

kayitlar.explanation: To make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to tackle a problem/issue.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government is determined to tackle inflation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to tackle the problem head-on.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I decided to tackle the housework this morning.

kayitlar.explanation: Not having as many representatives as would be expected.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Women are still underrepresented in many senior positions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Minority groups are underrepresented in the local government.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The university is trying to attract students from underrepresented backgrounds.

kayitlar.explanation: To support something publicly; a person who supports a cause.
kayitlar.note:
Verb/Noun.
Kullanım: to strongly advocate sth; an advocate of/for sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is a strong advocate of women's rights.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He has advocated for legal reform for many years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The group advocates using renewable energy sources.

kayitlar.explanation: With a name that is not known or that is not made public.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: an anonymous phone call/letter.

kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Police received an anonymous tip-off about the robbery.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The author of the book is anonymous.

kayitlar.explanation: To forbid something officially; an official rule that says something is not allowed.
kayitlar.note:
Verb/Noun.
Kullanım: to ban sth; to put/lift a ban on sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government has banned smoking in public places.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a ban on using mobile phones while driving.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was banned from driving for six months.

kayitlar.explanation: To decide or settle something officially.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to determine to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They determined to start early the next morning.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Upbringing plays an important role in determining character.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The size of the chicken determines the cooking time.

kayitlar.explanation: The quality of trying to do something even if it is difficult.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She has great determination to succeed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His success was due to his hard work and determination.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You will need a lot of determination to finish this race.

kayitlar.explanation: Harm done to a person's body, especially in an accident.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He suffered a serious leg injury in the accident.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The team has been hit by a series of injuries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Luckily, her injuries were not life-threatening.

kayitlar.explanation: To introduce new ideas, methods or products.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Companies must innovate to remain competitive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The artist is constantly innovating and trying new techniques.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This company has innovated in the field of mobile technology.

kayitlar.explanation: A new idea, way of doing something, or device.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Technological innovation has changed the way we work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The school encourages innovation in teaching methods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This award is for innovation in the field of medicine.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of suggesting someone for a position, award, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a nomination for sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He received a nomination for Best Actor.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The nomination period closes next Friday.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Her nomination for the post was widely supported.

kayitlar.explanation: To suggest someone officially for a job, prize, or position.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to nominate sb for/as sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I would like to nominate Sarah for the position of chair.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was nominated for an Oscar for his latest film.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Several people have been nominated as candidates.

kayitlar.explanation: To disagree strongly with a plan, policy, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to strongly oppose (doing) sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Most residents oppose the new housing development.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I strongly oppose any change to the rules.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The two parties oppose each other on almost every issue.

kayitlar.explanation: A very strong feeling of love, hatred, anger, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to have passion for sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Music is his greatest passion in life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He spoke with great passion about his work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I don't have the same passion for cooking that you do.

kayitlar.explanation: To get well again after being ill, hurt, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to recover from sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is still recovering from a knee operation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The economy is beginning to recover from the recession.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It took her a long time to recover from the shock.
kayitlar.synonyms: heal, get better, bounce back, improve

kayitlar.explanation: A moral or legal claim to have or get something or to behave in a particular way.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to have the right to (do) sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Everyone has the right to a fair trial.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You have no right to talk to me like that.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He fought for civil rights throughout his life.

kayitlar.explanation: To travel to or around an area or a country in order to learn about it.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to explore outer space; to explore thoroughly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Scientists are exploring the deep ocean floor.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We should explore all the options before making a decision.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The astronauts explored the surface of the moon.

kayitlar.explanation: The curved path followed by a planet or an object as it moves around another body.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: to orbit the sun/moon.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The Earth orbits the sun once a year.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The satellite is now in stable orbit around the planet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The Moon orbited the Earth for billions of years.

kayitlar.explanation: To think about something until you understand it.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I can't figure out how to open this bottle.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We finally figured out what was wrong with the car.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I'm trying to figure out a way to save money.
kayitlar.antonyms: misunderstand, be confused, fail to grasp

kayitlar.explanation: Covering a large area; great in amount.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The fire caused extensive damage to the building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She has extensive knowledge of ancient history.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The school underwent extensive renovations over the summer.

kayitlar.explanation: To decide that something is true after considering all the information.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to conclude that + sentence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The jury concluded that he was guilty.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The report concludes that more investment is needed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I would like to conclude by thanking you all for coming.

kayitlar.explanation: To expect something and prepare for it.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to anticipate a problem; to anticipate that + sentence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is important to anticipate potential problems in advance.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The results were much better than we had anticipated.

kayitlar.explanation: One of several parts of which something is made.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: main component of sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Trust is a vital component of a good relationship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The factory produces components for aircraft engines.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Individual freedom is a key component of democracy.

kayitlar.explanation: To believe that something is important and deserves attention.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should take his advice seriously.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The threat of climate change must be taken seriously.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He doesn't seem to take his studies seriously.

kayitlar.explanation: To make it possible for somebody to do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to enable sb to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new software will enable us to work faster.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This scholarship enabled her to study abroad.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The internet enables people to stay in touch easily.

kayitlar.explanation: Almost or very nearly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is virtually impossible to find a parking space here.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The two twins look virtually identical.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He has virtually no experience in this field.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who has come to live permanently in a different country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The city has a large population of immigrants.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many immigrants face difficulties when they first arrive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His grandparents were immigrants from Italy.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who has the legal right to belong to a particular country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is now a British citizen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The rights of every citizen must be protected.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Citizens were asked to vote in the election.

kayitlar.explanation: The legal right to belong to a particular country.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to hold/apply for citizenship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He has applied for American citizenship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The process of gaining citizenship can take several years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She holds dual citizenship in Turkey and Germany.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who is related to somebody who lived a long time ago.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: descendants of immigrants; direct descendant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is a direct descendant of Queen Victoria.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many people in this area are descendants of settlers.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The tradition has been passed down to their descendants.

kayitlar.explanation: Not large, strong or important enough for a particular purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The food was insufficient to feed the whole crowd.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was released because of insufficient evidence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His knowledge of the subject is insufficient for this job.

kayitlar.explanation: That cannot be predicted because it changes a lot.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The weather here is very unpredictable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He has an unpredictable temper.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The stock market can be highly unpredictable.

kayitlar.explanation: The line that separates two countries.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a frontier between A and B.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They crossed the frontier at night.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The river forms a natural frontier between the two nations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Space is often called the 'final frontier'.

kayitlar.explanation: Happening all the time or repeatedly.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: constant stream of immigrants; constant attention.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The car was travelling at a constant speed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is in constant pain.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The machine needs constant maintenance.

kayitlar.explanation: That must be obeyed exactly.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: strict laws/rules/regulations; a strict parent/teacher.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: My parents were very strict with me.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There are strict rules about smoking in the office.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The doctor put her on a strict diet.

kayitlar.explanation: To become or make something become smaller in size, number, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb/Noun.
Kullanım: decrease from... to...; a decrease in sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The number of smokers has decreased significantly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company decided to decrease its spending.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There has been a sharp decrease in profits.

kayitlar.explanation: To introduce a new law, rule, tax, etc.; to force somebody to accept something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to impose a quota/restrictions; to impose sth on sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The council has imposed a ban on parking here.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: New taxes were imposed on luxury goods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I don't want to impose my views on you.

kayitlar.explanation: Determined to do something despite difficulties; continuing for a long time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She has a persistent cough that won't go away.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is a persistent salesman who never gives up.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The rain was persistent throughout the day.

kayitlar.explanation: Strange and frightening; different from what you are used to.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The idea of working for someone else is alien to me.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The movie is about an alien from another planet.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They found themselves in an alien culture.

kayitlar.explanation: Causing worry or fear.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: at an alarming rate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The crime rate is increasing at an alarming rate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The news about the forest fires is very alarming.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There has been an alarming rise in childhood obesity.

kayitlar.explanation: To get an advantage from something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb/Noun.
Kullanım: to benefit from sth.
