kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Who will benefit most from these changes?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I hope you benefit from your stay abroad.

kayitlar.explanation: Unacceptable or improper behaviour, especially by a professional person.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: professional misconduct; accused of misconduct.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The lawyer was sued for professional misconduct.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was fired for serious misconduct at work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The police officer was accused of misconduct during the arrest.

kayitlar.explanation: Something that is done in advance in order to avoid danger or problems.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: take necessary precautions against sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should take necessary precautions against fire.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The police took extra precautions during the visit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: As a precaution, the building was evacuated.

kayitlar.explanation: Good enough for a particular purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The results of the test were satisfactory.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We hope to reach a satisfactory solution to the problem.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His work has been entirely satisfactory so far.

kayitlar.explanation: The arrival of a large number of people or things.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The town has seen a huge influx of tourists this summer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The country is struggling to deal with the influx of refugees.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There has been a massive influx of foreign investment.

kayitlar.explanation: Not completely; to some extent.
kayitlar.note:
Adverb.
Kullanım: to partially help sth; partially responsible.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The building was partially destroyed by the fire.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The project was only partially successful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is partially deaf in one ear.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something continue at the same level; to keep in good condition.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to maintain control over sb/sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is important to maintain a healthy lifestyle.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company has maintained its position as market leader.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He maintained that he was innocent.
kayitlar.antonyms: abandon, give up, neglect, let go

kayitlar.explanation: The opportunity or right to use something or to see somebody/something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to have access to sth/the Internet/health care.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many people in rural areas still do not have access to good healthcare.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Students need easy access to the library's online resources.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The only access to the village is by a narrow mountain road.

kayitlar.explanation: Completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: essential to/for sb; it is essential to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Experienced staff are essential to the success of this project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is essential to keep all your documents in a safe place.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Vitamins are essential for maintaining good health.

kayitlar.explanation: Things that are produced to be sold.
kayitlar.note:
Noun (Plural).
Kullanım: essential/traded goods; to buy and sell goods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The shop sells a wide variety of leather goods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a high demand for luxury goods in this country.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company produces electronic goods for the international market.

kayitlar.explanation: To limit something or make it last for a shorter time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Spending on the arts has been drastically curtailed this year.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We had to curtail our holiday because of an unexpected emergency.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: New laws have been introduced to curtail the power of the police.

kayitlar.explanation: In the place of somebody/something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I'll have tea instead of coffee, please.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He decided to walk to work instead of taking the bus.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Why don't we go to the cinema instead of staying at home?
kayitlar.synonyms: in place of, rather than, as a substitute for

kayitlar.explanation: Extremely unusual and surprising.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The statistics reveal a startling increase in youth unemployment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She made a startling discovery during her research in the laboratory.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is a startling resemblance between the two cousins.

kayitlar.explanation: A space between two things; a big difference between two situations/groups.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the gap between the rich and the poor.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government is trying to bridge the gap between rich and poor.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a wide gap between his ideals and reality.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She squeezed through a small gap in the fence.

kayitlar.explanation: A situation, an event, etc. that makes it difficult for you to do or achieve something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to encounter/overcome an obstacle to sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Fear of failure is often the biggest obstacle to success.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The team had to overcome several technical obstacles to finish the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A lack of qualifications can be a serious obstacle to finding a job.

kayitlar.explanation: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: infectious diseases; to be (highly) infectious.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Flu is highly infectious, so you should stay at home.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The hospital has a special unit for patients with infectious diseases.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His enthusiasm for the project was infectious and everyone started working harder.

kayitlar.explanation: Money that is paid by a government or an organization to reduce the costs of services.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: an agricultural subsidy; to pay a subsidy to sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government provides a subsidy to farmers to keep food prices low.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Public transport relies heavily on government subsidies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The theatre would close without its annual state subsidy.

kayitlar.explanation: The basic systems and services, such as transport and power supplies, that a country or organization uses.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: infrastructure of a city/town.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The country's aging infrastructure needs urgent investment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The war caused serious damage to the city's infrastructure.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: New roads and bridges are a vital part of the nation's infrastructure.

kayitlar.explanation: To fail to understand somebody/something correctly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I think you completely misunderstood my point.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is very easy to misunderstand his intentions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She felt misunderstood by her parents throughout her childhood.

kayitlar.explanation: To think or accept that something is true but without having proof of it.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to assume that + sentence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Let's assume for a moment that the plan is successful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is a mistake to assume that everyone agrees with you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I assumed you were coming, so I bought an extra ticket.
kayitlar.synonyms: suppose, presume, believe, take for granted

kayitlar.explanation: A belief or feeling that something is true although there is no proof.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to make an assumption (about sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His actions were based on a false assumption.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We should not make assumptions about people based on their appearance.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The project was started on the assumption that funding would be available.

kayitlar.explanation: To pay no attention to something/somebody.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You shouldn't ignore the warning signs of stress.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He felt ignored by his colleagues during the meeting.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She chose to ignore his rude comments and walked away.

kayitlar.explanation: Not by accident; deliberately.
kayitlar.note:
Phrase.
Kullanım: to do sth on purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I'm sorry, I didn't break the vase on purpose.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He arrived late on purpose just to annoy her.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Do you think he left the door open on purpose?

kayitlar.explanation: Many times.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I have repeatedly asked him to clean his room.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The warning has been ignored repeatedly by the local residents.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has won the award repeatedly over the last few years.
kayitlar.synonyms: again and again, frequently, continually, over and over

kayitlar.explanation: To rely on somebody/something and be able to trust them.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb.
Kullanım: to greatly/mainly/entirely depend on sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Whether we go out for a walk depends on the weather.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The success of the project depends on everyone working together.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
kayitlar.synonyms: rely on, count on, trust, be subject to

kayitlar.explanation: To try to reach an agreement by formal discussion.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to (attempt/manage/try to) negotiate with sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government is refusing to negotiate with the strikers.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They managed to negotiate a better deal for the company.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I need to negotiate a new contract with my employer.

kayitlar.explanation: To say that you are sorry for doing something wrong.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to apologize (for doing sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He apologized for being late to the meeting.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You should apologize to her for what you said.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The airline apologized for the delay in the flight.
kayitlar.synonyms: say sorry, express regret, ask for forgiveness

kayitlar.explanation: To have a plan, result or purpose in your mind when you do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to intend to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I fully intend to pay you back as soon as I can.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: What do you intend to do after you graduate?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The book is intended for young children.

kayitlar.explanation: What you plan or aim to do.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to have the intention of doing sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I have no intention of changing my mind.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He left the country with the intention of starting a new life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It was not my intention to cause any offence.

kayitlar.explanation: To not include something/somebody, either deliberately or by accident.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Please don't omit any important details from the report.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His name was omitted from the list of guests.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You can omit the second chapter if you are in a hurry.

kayitlar.explanation: Very bad or unpleasant.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: a dreadful experience; feel/be/look dreadful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We had a dreadful journey through the snow.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I've got a dreadful headache today.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What a dreadful thing to say to someone!

kayitlar.explanation: The fact of being in a particular place.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Your presence is requested at the meeting tomorrow.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The police presence at the stadium was very high.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She felt calmed by his quiet presence in the room.

kayitlar.explanation: To interrupt somebody when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I'm sorry to disturb you, but there's a phone call for you.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Do not disturb the baby while he is sleeping.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The noise from the street disturbed my sleep all night.

kayitlar.explanation: Having an unreasonable dislike of a group of people or things.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be/seem (deeply/racially) prejudiced (against sb).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The jury was warned not to be prejudiced against the defendant.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Some people are still prejudiced against certain minority groups.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He gave a very prejudiced account of the events.

kayitlar.explanation: Made or produced to copy something natural; not real.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The product contains no artificial colors or flavors.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She wore a bunch of artificial flowers in her hair.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.

kayitlar.explanation: To come together, or bring people together, in one place to form a group.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A large crowd gathered to watch the opening ceremony.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She gathered her things and left the room quickly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Detectives are still gathering evidence about the crime.

kayitlar.explanation: That needs to be dealt with or happen immediately.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The house is in urgent need of repair.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He sent an urgent message asking for help.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The problem requires an urgent solution before it's too late.

kayitlar.explanation: To get something, especially by making an effort.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to obtain sth (from sb).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You must obtain permission from the council before building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Further information can be obtained from the local library.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He managed to obtain a copy of the report.

kayitlar.explanation: To recognize or show that two things are not the same.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to differentiate between two things / A from B.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It's difficult to differentiate between the two types of bacteria.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A good teacher should be able to differentiate the needs of each student.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The unique design of the car differentiates it from its competitors.

kayitlar.explanation: To attract and keep someone's interest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The story was designed to engage the reader's attention.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He found it hard to engage the students in the lesson.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is important to engage with the local community.

kayitlar.explanation: To take part in something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Most students engage in extracurricular activities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They were engaged in a deep conversation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He refused to engage in any political debate.

kayitlar.explanation: To have existed since a particular time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The custom dates back to ancient times.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This tradition dates back over 100 years.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Their friendship dates back to their high school days.

kayitlar.explanation: Very great or intense.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The discovery has profound implications for science.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He felt a profound sense of relief.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Her death had a profound effect on his life.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that is very great or intense.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The experience profoundly changed her life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We were profoundly grateful for the help.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The results were profoundly disappointing.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with the inside of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company is conducting an internal investigation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Internal injuries are often hard to detect.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need to deal with our internal affairs first.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that exists inside something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The drug is used to treat bleeding internally.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The problem was solved internally within the team.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was suffering internally despite his calm look.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with the outside of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The exam is marked by an external examiner.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Apply the cream to the external parts of the skin.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The project needs external funding to continue.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that relates to the outside of something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The house looked fine externally but was ruined inside.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The software is hosted externally by a provider.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company's image is managed externally by a PR firm.

kayitlar.explanation: Not interesting or exciting.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The lecture was quite dull and long.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It was a dull day with a grey sky.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Life in the countryside can be dull for young people.

kayitlar.explanation: To achieve what was hoped for or expected.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He finally fulfilled his dream of traveling.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You must fulfill all the requirements for the job.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company failed to fulfill the order on time.

kayitlar.explanation: Causing a feeling of satisfaction.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Nursing is a very fulfilling career.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He led a long and fulfilling life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Helping others is a fulfilling experience.

kayitlar.explanation: The feeling of being happy with what you are doing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She found fulfillment in her art.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The fulfillment of his promises took time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The job provides little personal fulfillment.

kayitlar.explanation: To emphasize that something is important.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The report underlines the need for reform.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her actions underline her commitment to the cause.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I must underline the importance of punctuality.

kayitlar.explanation: Important but not immediately obvious.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We must find the underlying cause of the disease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The underlying message of the film is peace.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Stress was the underlying reason for his failure.

kayitlar.explanation: A natural desire to behave in a certain way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He has a propensity to exaggerate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a propensity for violence in some areas.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The study noted a propensity to take risks among youth.

kayitlar.explanation: Doing or achieving a lot.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The meeting was highly productive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He had a very productive day at work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We are looking for more productive ways of working.

kayitlar.explanation: The rate at which goods are produced.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: New technology boosted factory productivity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Bonus schemes can improve worker productivity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The country's productivity has fallen recently.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that produces good results.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They spent the afternoon working productively.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Learn to use your time more productively.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The project started productively but soon slowed down.

kayitlar.explanation: To take someone to a police station formally.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The suspect was arrested near the scene.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Police arrested three men during the raid.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You are under arrest for theft.

kayitlar.explanation: To formally accuse someone of a crime.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was charged with assault.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The police dropped the charges against her.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What is the specific charge against him?

kayitlar.explanation: To say that someone did something wrong.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She accused him of stealing her idea.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Don't accuse me without any evidence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They were accused of bribery.

kayitlar.explanation: A statement that someone is guilty.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He denied the accusation of fraud.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: False accusations can ruin a person's life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She made serious accusations against the manager.

kayitlar.explanation: Not real; a copy meant to deceive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The painting turned out to be a fake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He faked his signature on the contract.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She wore fake fur to the party.

kayitlar.explanation: To agree that something is true.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He finally admitted his mistake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She admitted to taking the money.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They admitted that the plan was flawed.

kayitlar.explanation: To find or follow by looking at signs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Police are tracing the phone call.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She disappeared without a trace.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The problem was traced to a faulty wire.

kayitlar.explanation: Real and not fake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This is a genuine leather jacket.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He showed a genuine interest in her work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The museum confirmed the coin was genuine.

kayitlar.explanation: A feeling of great pleasure.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The children cried out in delight.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The book is a delight to read.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: To my great delight, I passed the exam.

kayitlar.explanation: Used to show that a name is incorrect.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Where are your so-called friends now?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This so-called expert knows nothing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The so-called peace deal failed quickly.

kayitlar.explanation: In a careful and private way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She discreetly checked her watch.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The problem was handled discreetly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He whispered the news discreetly.

kayitlar.explanation: Careful in speech and action.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He made some discreet inquiries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A discreet lawyer is always trusted.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You should be more discreet about it.

kayitlar.explanation: To become an expert in one area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This shop specializes in rare books.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She decided to specialize in pediatrics.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The lawyer specializes in criminal law.

kayitlar.explanation: To make someone have a particular feeling.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His behavior aroused my suspicion.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The book aroused great interest in history.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Her comments aroused a lot of anger.

kayitlar.explanation: Feeling shame or embarrassment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He felt ashamed of his rude behavior.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She was ashamed to admit her failure.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: You should be ashamed of yourself.

kayitlar.explanation: A strong desire for more money or power.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The war was motivated by greed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Greed can destroy a person's life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His actions were driven by pure greed.

kayitlar.explanation: Wanting more than you need.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Don't be greedy; share with others.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is a greedy man who only wants money.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She was greedy for fame and power.

kayitlar.explanation: To treat someone unfairly for your own benefit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Companies exploit workers for profit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We must learn to exploit natural resources.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He exploited her kindness for years.

kayitlar.explanation: The unfair treatment of someone.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Exploitation of child labor is a crime.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The film deals with economic exploitation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We must end the exploitation of the poor.

kayitlar.explanation: To act dishonestly to gain an advantage.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was caught cheating in the exam.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She cheated him out of his money.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Don't cheat; play by the rules.

kayitlar.explanation: A formal meeting in court to decide guilt.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The murder trial lasted for three weeks.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is currently on trial for fraud.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The trial will begin next Monday.

kayitlar.explanation: Attention given to something by the media.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The movie received a lot of publicity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Bad publicity can ruin a reputation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She avoids publicity at all costs.

kayitlar.explanation: To start to be seen; to be on TV.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She will appear on TV tonight.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: A bus appeared around the corner.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He appeared to be very tired.

kayitlar.explanation: Unusual or surprising in a good way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She has a remarkable talent for music.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The recovery was truly remarkable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This is a remarkable achievement.

kayitlar.explanation: Facts that show something is true.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is clear evidence of climate change.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Police are looking for direct evidence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Is there any evidence to prove this?

kayitlar.explanation: To show that something exists or is true.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The sign indicates the way to the exit.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Research indicates that salt is harmful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His smile indicated his happiness.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something smaller in size or amount.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We need to reduce our salt intake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company is trying to reduce costs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The price has been reduced by 10%.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of making something less.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There has been a reduction in crime.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We hope for a reduction in taxes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A significant reduction in pollution is needed.

kayitlar.explanation: Feeling worried about something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I am concerned about your health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Parents are concerned about safety.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She is concerned that she might fail.

kayitlar.explanation: Greater than what is normal or reasonable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Excessive drinking is bad for health.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They used excessive force in the arrest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The cost of the project was excessive.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that is too much.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He drinks excessively at weekends.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The movie was excessively long.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She worries excessively about her kids.

kayitlar.explanation: To make goods in large amounts.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The firm manufactures car parts.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: These toys are manufactured in China.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We manufacture high-quality furniture.

kayitlar.explanation: A person or firm that makes goods.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Faulty goods should be sent back to the manufacturer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is a leading car manufacturer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The manufacturer offers a one-year warranty.

kayitlar.explanation: Unwilling to do something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She was reluctant to admit her mistake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many people are reluctant to talk about it.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He gave a reluctant smile.

kayitlar.explanation: To make someone notice something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He pointed out the mistakes in the report.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The guide pointed out the main sights.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I must point out that time is short.

kayitlar.explanation: Amount of food/drink you take in.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Reduce your daily intake of sugar.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: What is your average calorie intake?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The doctor checked his water intake.

kayitlar.explanation: Completely necessary.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Experience is essential for this job.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Water is essential for survival.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It is essential to stay calm.

kayitlar.explanation: Substance needed to stay alive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Vegetables are full of nutrients.

kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They sat idly on the beach, watching the waves.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He cannot sit idly while others are working so hard.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The machines stood idly in the factory during the strike.

kayitlar.explanation: Not likely to move, change or fail.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: a stable cultural environment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Children need a stable home environment to grow up happily.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The political situation in the country is now more stable.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The patient is in a stable condition after the operation.

kayitlar.explanation: Used to describe a feeling that two or more people have for each other.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: mutual rights and obligations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: A healthy relationship is based on mutual respect and trust.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They discovered that they had many mutual friends.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The agreement was reached for the mutual benefit of both companies.

kayitlar.explanation: Showing feelings of love or liking.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is a very affectionate child who loves to hug everyone.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She gave him an affectionate smile before she left.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They have a very affectionate relationship with their grandparents.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that shows love or liking.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He looked affectionately at his newborn daughter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The old house was affectionately known as 'The Nest'.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She spoke affectionately about her childhood in the village.

kayitlar.explanation: A feeling of liking or love and caring.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Children need a lot of love and affection from their parents.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He has a great affection for his old school.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She held him with deep affection as he said goodbye.

kayitlar.explanation: Feelings of worry or lack of trust between people or groups.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The talks were held to reduce the tensions between the two countries.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Family tensions can sometimes lead to serious arguments.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He felt a lot of nervous tension before the job interview.

kayitlar.explanation: To continue to have something; to keep something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company managed to retain its market share despite the competition.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You should retain all your receipts for tax purposes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has a remarkable ability to retain complex information.
kayitlar.synonyms: keep, maintain, preserve, hold on to

kayitlar.explanation: Interested in something; worried about something.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be concerned with sth/sb.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This report is mainly concerned with the problem of pollution.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Parents are often concerned about their children's safety online.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government is concerned that the economy might slow down.

kayitlar.explanation: Developing from or being strongly influenced by something.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be rooted in sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His problems are deeply rooted in his childhood experiences.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The conflict is rooted in a long history of disagreement.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Traditional values are firmly rooted in the local culture.

kayitlar.explanation: The process by which characteristics are passed from parents to children.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Heredity plays a major role in determining a person's physical features.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Scientists are studying the effects of environment versus heredity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Certain personality traits are believed to be influenced by heredity.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that shows interest; in a strange or unusual way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The children looked curiously at the strange animal.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Curiously, the door was unlocked even though everyone was away.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She watched him curiously as he opened the mysterious package.

kayitlar.explanation: Having a strong desire to know about something.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be curious about sth / to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I was curious to know what would happen at the end of the story.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She is a curious child who always asks 'why?'.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They were curious about the history of the ancient ruins.

kayitlar.explanation: A strong desire to know about something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: curiosity about sth / to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His curiosity about space led him to become an astronaut.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Children have a natural curiosity about the world around them.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The book aims to satisfy the reader's curiosity about ancient history.

kayitlar.explanation: A clear difference or contrast between people or things.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: make/draw a distinction between A and B.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It is important to make a distinction between fact and opinion.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The law draws a clear distinction between minor and serious crimes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is no real distinction between the two versions of the software.

kayitlar.explanation: Clearly different from something else of the same type.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be distinct from sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The two languages are quite distinct from each other.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a distinct possibility that the plan will fail.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The region has a distinct culture and its own unique traditions.

kayitlar.explanation: Without being helped or influenced by anyone or anything else.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Students are encouraged to work independently on their projects.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She has lived independently since she was eighteen years old.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The two research teams reached the same conclusion independently.

kayitlar.explanation: Behaving in a sensible way, like an adult.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is very mature for his age and handles responsibility well.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She made a mature decision to stay and finish her studies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The project requires a mature approach to problem-solving.

kayitlar.explanation: Passed from parent to child through genes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Diabetes can be a hereditary condition in some families.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The doctors asked if there were any hereditary diseases in her family.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Color blindness is often a hereditary problem passed from parents.

kayitlar.explanation: Based on instinct rather than thought or training.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His reaction to the danger was purely instinctive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Motherhood seems to bring out an instinctive protective behavior.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She had an instinctive feeling that something was wrong.

kayitlar.explanation: By using instinct rather than thought.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He instinctively moved his hand away from the hot stove.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The bird instinctively knew how to build its nest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She instinctively distrusted the man as soon as she saw him.

kayitlar.explanation: A natural quality that makes people or animals behave in a particular way.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: instinct to do sth / based on instinct.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Birds have an amazing instinct to migrate over long distances.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her first instinct was to run away from the scary situation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I trusted my gut instinct and decided not to sign the contract.

kayitlar.explanation: Exactly the same.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The two sisters are identical twins and look exactly the same.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His signature was identical to the one on the document.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They live in identical houses on the same street.

kayitlar.explanation: Something that helps somebody/something to develop or become more active.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new tax cuts provided a stimulus for the local economy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The brain responds to different visual stimuli in various ways.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The success of the first book was a stimulus for him to write more.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something develop or become more active.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The exhibition stimulated a lot of interest in the artist's work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Caffeine is a substance that can stimulate the nervous system.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government is trying to stimulate growth in the housing market.

kayitlar.explanation: To use somebody/something instead of another person or thing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You can substitute margarine for butter in this recipe.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The coach decided to substitute the tired player in the second half.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There is no substitute for hard work and dedication.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of using somebody/something instead of another person or thing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The substitution of plastic for metal has made the car much lighter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The manager made a tactical substitution late in the game.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Sugar substitution is common in many modern diet products.

kayitlar.explanation: Made or produced to copy something natural; not real.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The product contains no artificial colors or flavors.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She wore a bunch of artificial flowers in her hair.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that is not natural.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The prices of these goods have been artificially kept high.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The plants were grown artificially in a controlled laboratory.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The lake was created artificially as part of the new park.

kayitlar.explanation: Introducing or using new ideas, ways of doing something, etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company is famous for its innovative approach to design.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to find innovative solutions to our current problems.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His innovative ideas have revolutionized the entire industry.

kayitlar.explanation: To allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: permit sb to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The law does not permit smoking in public buildings.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We were not permitted to take photos inside the museum.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: If the weather permits, we will have a picnic in the park tomorrow.

kayitlar.explanation: The limits between which something varies.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: range from A to B.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The hotel offers a wide range of facilities for its guests.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The temperatures will range from 15 to 25 degrees today.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The store sells a range of products, from clothing to electronics.

kayitlar.explanation: To build or make something such as a road, building or machine.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The workers are currently constructing a new bridge over the river.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The theory was constructed after years of careful research.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They used local materials to construct a simple shelter in the woods.

kayitlar.explanation: To provide what is needed or wanted.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new library was built to satisfy the needs of the community.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I hope this explanation satisfies your curiosity about the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company must satisfy all safety regulations to continue operating.

kayitlar.explanation: A good feeling that you get when you have achieved or received what you wanted.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She gets a lot of satisfaction from helping people in her job.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Customer satisfaction is the most important goal for our company.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He looked at his finished work with a great deal of satisfaction.

kayitlar.explanation: To make an unpleasant feeling or situation less strong or severe.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: relieve an unpleasant feeling.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The medicine helped to relieve the pain in his leg.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We were relieved to hear that everyone was safe after the storm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Breathing exercises can help to relieve stress and anxiety.

kayitlar.explanation: The feeling of happiness that you have when something unpleasant stops.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: It was a great relief to find my lost keys under the sofa.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The rain brought much-needed relief after the long heatwave.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He gave a sigh of relief when the exam was finally over.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that must be obeyed exactly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Smoking is strictly forbidden in all parts of the building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The rules of the game must be strictly followed by all players.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The security guards were told to strictly check every visitor.

kayitlar.explanation: To examine books, films, etc. and remove parts that are considered to be offensive or a political threat.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: to censor a book/film.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government decided to censor the news reports during the crisis.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He works as a censor for a large social media company.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The movie was heavily censored before it was allowed to be shown in cinemas.

kayitlar.explanation: The policy or practice of examining books, films, etc. and removing parts that are considered offensive.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: impose/lift censorship; strict/political/press censorship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new law was criticized for introducing strict press censorship.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many artists are fighting against government censorship of their work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The Internet has made it much more difficult to maintain effective censorship.

kayitlar.explanation: To keep somebody in an official place, such as a police station, and prevent them from leaving.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to be detained for sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Several people were detained by the police for questioning after the protest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was detained at the airport because of a problem with his visa.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The suspect is being detained in custody until the trial begins.

kayitlar.explanation: A situation which makes problems, often one in which you have to make a very difficult choice between two things of equal importance.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: face a dilemma; a moral/ethical/political dilemma.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She was faced with a difficult dilemma: should she stay or leave?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The doctor was in a moral dilemma about whether to tell the patient the truth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The country's leaders are in a dilemma over how to handle the economic crisis.

kayitlar.explanation: To annoy or upset somebody by actually doing something unpleasant to them many times.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was accused of harassing his colleagues at work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The paparazzi continue to harass the actress everywhere she goes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Stop harassing me with all these unnecessary questions!

kayitlar.explanation: The act of annoying or upsetting somebody many times.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company has a very strict policy against sexual harassment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many women experience some form of street harassment in big cities.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She decided to report the harassment to the police.

kayitlar.explanation: Cruel, severe and unkind.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He received a very harsh punishment for a minor crime.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The winter weather in this region can be extremely harsh.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She faced harsh criticism from the media after her controversial comments.

kayitlar.explanation: In a cruel, severe or unkind way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The prisoners were treated harshly by the guards.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Don't judge him too harshly; he's had a very difficult life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The manager spoke harshly to the staff about their poor performance.

kayitlar.explanation: Unwilling to obey rules or accept normal standards of behaviour.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was a rebellious teenager who often got into trouble at school.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The rebellious troops refused to follow the general's orders.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She has a rebellious streak and likes to do things her own way.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who fights against the government or of authority.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: rebel forces/leaders; to rebel against sb/sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The rebel forces have taken control of the capital city.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Teenagers often rebel against their parents' authority.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was always a bit of a rebel when he was younger.

kayitlar.explanation: An attempt by some of the people in a country to change their government using violence.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: armed/open rebellion; suppress rebellion.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The army quickly suppressed the armed rebellion in the north.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The students' protest was an act of open rebellion against the new rules.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He led a rebellion against the king two hundred years ago.

kayitlar.explanation: To control something by means of rules.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government needs to regulate the banking industry more strictly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: This valve is used to regulate the flow of water into the tank.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Laws were introduced to regulate the use of pesticides in farming.

kayitlar.explanation: Official rules made by a government or another authority.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: All staff must follow the company's safety regulations.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The new government regulations will affect small businesses.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Environmental regulations have become much stricter in recent years.

kayitlar.explanation: To say officially in court that somebody is to receive a particular punishment.
kayitlar.note:
Verb/Noun.
Kullanım: to sentence sb to sth; a death/life/prison sentence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The judge sentenced him to five years in prison for the robbery.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She was sentenced to community service for her minor crime.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The prisoner is currently serving a life sentence for murder.

kayitlar.explanation: To stop something by using force.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government used the police to suppress the student movement.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He tried hard to suppress his anger during the argument.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Drugs can be used to suppress the immune system during a transplant.

kayitlar.explanation: Careful when dealing with somebody/something because you think that there may be a danger or problem.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be wary of/about sb or sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You should be wary of strangers who ask for personal information.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company is wary about investing in new technology at the moment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He gave me a wary look when I asked him about his past.

kayitlar.explanation: To choose somebody for a job or position of responsibility.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They decided to appoint a new manager for the local branch.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She was appointed as the head of the research department.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: A special committee was appointed to investigate the scandal.

kayitlar.explanation: Almost no; almost not; only with great difficulty.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I could hardly hear what he was saying over the noise.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There was hardly any food left in the fridge.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She hardly ever goes out during the week because she's so busy.

kayitlar.explanation: The parts of a building that remain after it has been destroyed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They visited the ruins of an ancient temple in Greece.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The fire left the historic building in ruins.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Archaeologists are excavating the ruins of the Roman city.

kayitlar.explanation: To begin a journey; to make something happen.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We set off early in the morning to avoid the traffic.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The loud noise set off the car alarm.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His comments set off a heated debate among the students.

kayitlar.explanation: Very surprised.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be astonished by sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I was astonished by the news of his sudden departure.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They were astonished to see how much the city had changed.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She looked astonished when she heard that she had won the first prize.

kayitlar.explanation: Extremely attractive and impressive; deserving to be admired.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely magnificent.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The hotel is housed in a magnificent 18th-century palace.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She made a magnificent performance that captivated the audience.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something known to somebody.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The survey revealed that most people are unhappy with the service.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He refused to reveal the source of his information.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The curtains opened to reveal a beautiful stage set.

kayitlar.explanation: An occasion when a volcano explodes and sends out hot rock and ash.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The volcanic eruption caused widespread destruction in the area.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Scientists are monitoring the volcano for signs of an imminent eruption.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The massive eruption sent a huge cloud of ash into the atmosphere.

kayitlar.explanation: To leave a person, place or thing, especially one that you are responsible for.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They had to abandon their car in the snow and walk home.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The village was abandoned after the earthquake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He decided to abandon his career in law and become an artist.
kayitlar.synonyms: desert, forsake, give up, leave behind

kayitlar.explanation: The state of being successful, especially in making money.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: economic/global prosperity; a period of prosperity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The country is enjoying a period of economic prosperity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Education is the key to national prosperity and success.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The goal of the new policy is to bring prosperity to the entire region.

kayitlar.explanation: Rich and successful.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The city has a prosperous financial district.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He was a prosperous businessman with many successful companies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The region has become more prosperous since the new factory opened.

kayitlar.explanation: A change in position or direction.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a/the shift from X to Y.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There has been a significant shift in public opinion on this issue.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company is planning a shift in its marketing strategy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We are seeing a global shift towards renewable energy sources.

kayitlar.explanation: To imagine what a situation will be like in the future.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: They envision a world where everyone has access to clean water.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The architect envisioned a building that was both beautiful and functional.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: How do you envision your life in ten years' time?

kayitlar.explanation: The money that you make in business or by selling things.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company made a huge profit of $5 million last year.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Their main goal is to maximize profits for their shareholders.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Selling the house brought them a significant profit.

kayitlar.explanation: A great change in conditions, ways of working, beliefs, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: scientific/social/cultural revolution; revolution in sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The industrial revolution changed the way people lived and worked.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The invention of the internet caused a revolution in communication.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: There was a revolution in the way people thought about human rights.

kayitlar.explanation: Involving a great or complete change.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company introduced a revolutionary new type of battery.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His revolutionary ideas were initially rejected by the scientific community.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She was a revolutionary leader who fought for social justice.

kayitlar.explanation: To completely change the way that something is done.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new software has revolutionized the way we manage data.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Social media has revolutionized how people stay in touch.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: This discovery could revolutionize the treatment of cancer.

kayitlar.explanation: To suggest a plan, an idea, etc. for people to think about and decide on.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to propose (doing) sth; to propose that + S + V.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government has proposed a new law to reduce pollution.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He proposed starting the meeting an hour earlier.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: I propose that we take a break for lunch now.

kayitlar.explanation: A formal suggestion or plan.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: proposal to do sth; proposal for sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The committee is currently considering your proposal.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His proposal for a new research project was accepted.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The mayor made a proposal to build a new park in the city center.

kayitlar.explanation: To pass a law.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government is planning to enact new laws on environmental protection.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The bill was enacted by parliament last week.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: New safety regulations were enacted after the accident.

kayitlar.explanation: The process of a law being passed.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the enactment of the bill.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The enactment of the new policy took several months of negotiation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We are waiting for the enactment of the law before we take action.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The enactment of civil rights legislation changed the country.

kayitlar.explanation: A law or a set of laws passed by a parliament.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: New legislation will be introduced to control the sale of alcohol.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The parliament passed legislation to protect children's rights.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Environmental legislation has helped to reduce pollution levels.

kayitlar.explanation: To start to do something new or difficult.
kayitlar.note:
Phrasal Verb.
Kullanım: embark on/upon sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is about to embark on a new career in teaching.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company has embarked on a major research program.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government has embarked on a series of economic reforms.
kayitlar.synonyms: start, begin, launch, set out on

kayitlar.explanation: An impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a sense of accomplishment; a remarkable/significant accomplishment.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Finishing the marathon was a great personal accomplishment for her.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The completion of the new bridge is a major accomplishment for the city.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He has many impressive academic accomplishments to his name.

kayitlar.explanation: To succeed in doing or completing something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: You can accomplish anything if you work hard enough.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The team worked together to accomplish the mission on time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: What do you hope to accomplish during your stay here?

kayitlar.explanation: That can be trusted to do something well; that you can rely on.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is a very reliable employee who never misses a deadline.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need a reliable car for our long journey.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The study provides reliable data on the effects of the new drug.

kayitlar.explanation: Saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He is an outspoken critic of the government's economic policies.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She is known for being outspoken and always speaking her mind.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: His outspoken comments caused a lot of controversy.

kayitlar.explanation: To strongly criticize somebody/something that you think is wrong, illegal, etc.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to denounce sb/sth (as sth).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The president issued a statement to denounce the violence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She denounced the new policy as unfair and discriminatory.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was denounced to the police by his own neighbor.

kayitlar.explanation: To make a deeply felt request for something; the quality of being attractive.
kayitlar.note:
Noun/Verb.
Kullanım: an appeal to values/laws; to appeal to sb or sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The government made an appeal to the public to stay calm during the crisis.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His music appeals to people of all ages because of its universal themes.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They decided to appeal to a higher court to change the previous decision.

kayitlar.explanation: About something; involving somebody or something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I am writing to you concerning your recent application for the position.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There are several important issues concerning the safety of the new building.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The company issued a statement concerning the changes in its management.

kayitlar.explanation: To get something, especially an advantage or a pleasant feeling, from something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to derive a benefit/pleasure/enjoyment from sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Many people derive great pleasure from gardening on the weekends.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The new drug is derived from a rare plant found in the rainforest.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He derives much of his income from his investments in real estate.

kayitlar.explanation: A calm and serious manner that deserves respect.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: to have/live with/die with dignity; human dignity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She behaved with great dignity throughout the difficult trial.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It is important to protect the human dignity of every individual.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He wanted to die with dignity, surrounded by his family and friends.

kayitlar.explanation: Having a particular attitude or being likely to do something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb collocation.
Kullanım: to be disposed to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She seems well disposed towards our new proposal for the project.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Some people are genetically disposed to certain medical conditions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The manager was not disposed to grant his request for a salary increase.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The use of animals in medical research is a complex ethical issue.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Doctors must follow strict ethical guidelines when treating patients.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Companies are facing more pressure to behave in an ethical manner.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that is connected with beliefs about what is right and wrong.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Is it ethically acceptable to use technology in this specific way?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company strives to act ethically in all its business dealings.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We need to consider whether our actions are ethically justifiable.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with the principles of right and wrong behaviour.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The book tells a story with a very clear moral message.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He felt he had a moral obligation to help his old friend.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: We are facing a difficult moral dilemma regarding the environment.

kayitlar.explanation: Principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong behaviour.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the morality of sth (decision, action etc.).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The film questions the morality of using violence for a good cause.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Standards of morality can vary significantly from one culture to another.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is a man of high morality who always tries to do the right thing.

kayitlar.explanation: That can be defended or explained as being right.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The high cost of the project is justifiable because of the long-term benefits.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Is the use of force ever morally justifiable in a modern society?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She had a justifiable reason for being absent from the meeting.

kayitlar.explanation: To show that somebody/something is right or reasonable.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to justify an action etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: How can you justify spending so much money on a new car?
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The results of the experiment justify the hard work we put in.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He tried to justify his behavior, but nobody was convinced by his excuses.

kayitlar.explanation: A good reason why something exists or is done.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: justification for doing sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: There is no justification for such cruel treatment of animals.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: What is your justification for making these drastic changes?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The report provides a detailed justification for the new policy.

kayitlar.explanation: To confuse somebody very much.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The complex instructions on the box perplexed even the experts.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: His sudden change of mind continues to perplex his colleagues.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The mysterious clues in the case perplexed the entire police force.

kayitlar.explanation: Making you feel confused or worried because you do not understand something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: I found the ending of the movie to be very perplexing and strange.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The scientists are trying to solve a perplexing mystery about the stars.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She asked me a perplexing question that I couldn't answer immediately.

kayitlar.explanation: To make something last longer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new treatment is designed to prolong the lives of cancer patients.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We decided to prolong our stay by another two days.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Try to avoid anything that might prolong the conflict between the groups.

kayitlar.explanation: Continuing for a long time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The country suffered from a prolonged period of economic recession.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Prolonged exposure to the sun can be very harmful to your skin.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She needed a long break after a prolonged illness.

kayitlar.explanation: To do something or try to achieve something over a period of time.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to pursue a goal/an interest/a career.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She decided to move to New York to pursue a career in fashion.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company is pursuing a new marketing strategy to increase sales.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He has been pursuing his interest in photography for many years.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of looking for or trying to get something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the pursuit of sth (happiness, liberty etc.).
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The company is constant in its pursuit of excellence and quality.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: They moved to the country in pursuit of a quieter way of life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The detective was tireless in his pursuit of the truth.

kayitlar.explanation: To show the image of something; to think carefully about something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to reflect on sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The quiet lake reflected the surrounding mountains perfectly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The survey results reflect the public's concern about the economy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He took a moment to reflect on his achievements over the past year.

kayitlar.explanation: An image in a mirror or water; careful thought about something.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: a reflection on/about sb/sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She looked at her reflection in the shop window and smiled.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The book is a deep reflection on the nature of human life.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: After some reflection, he decided to accept the job offer.

kayitlar.explanation: To find an acceptable solution to a problem or difficulty.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to resolve an issue/a problem/conflict/crisis.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The two companies managed to resolve their dispute through negotiation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We need to resolve these technical issues before we can launch the product.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She was determined to resolve the conflict with her neighbor peacefully.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of solving or settling a problem or disagreement.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: the resolution of a problem etc.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The UN is working towards a peaceful resolution of the conflict.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her New Year's resolution was to exercise more and eat healthy.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The dispute was brought to a successful resolution after many weeks.

kayitlar.explanation: To try very hard to achieve something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to strive after/for sth; to strive to do sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We must strive for a world where everyone is treated equally.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The school strives to provide a safe environment for all its students.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Artists often strive to create something unique and meaningful.
kayitlar.synonyms: struggle, try hard, endeavor, work hard

kayitlar.explanation: The science or practice of farming.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: Most of the people in this region depend on agriculture for their living.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: New technologies are changing the face of modern agriculture.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The government is trying to encourage sustainable practices in agriculture.

kayitlar.explanation: Connected with the science or practice of farming.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The country exports a wide range of agricultural products.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The local economy is heavily based on agricultural production.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Environmental changes are affecting agricultural areas around the world.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who gives something, especially money or blood/organs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The hospital is looking for potential organ donors to save lives.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He is a regular blood donor and visits the clinic every few months.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The museum was built thanks to a generous donation from an anonymous donor.

kayitlar.explanation: To give money, food, clothes, etc. to somebody/something, especially a charity.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to donate an organ/blood/money.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He decided to donate all his old books to the local school library.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Many people donated money to help the victims of the earthquake.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She donated blood for the first time during the charity drive.

kayitlar.explanation: Something that is given to a person or an organization such as a charity.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The charity relies on private donations to continue its work.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Organ donation is a vital act that can save many lives.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They made a large donation to the hospital's new cancer unit.

kayitlar.explanation: To increase or further improve the good quality or value of something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to enhance a level/quality/characteristic.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: This new software will enhance the performance of your computer.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The chef added some spices to enhance the flavor of the dish.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Taking a course can help you enhance your job prospects.

kayitlar.explanation: An understanding of what something is like or why it happens.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: gain/produce an insight into sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The book provides a fascinating insight into the life of the artist.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Her research offers a new insight into the causes of the disease.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Visiting the factory gave us an insight into the production process.

kayitlar.explanation: To control or influence somebody/something, often in a dishonest way.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was accused of trying to manipulate the results of the election.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Advertisers often try to manipulate our emotions to make us buy things.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The data was manipulated to show a more positive outcome.

kayitlar.explanation: The act of controlling or influencing somebody/something cleverly or unfairly.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: manipulation of an organism/person.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The manipulation of genetic material is a highly controversial topic.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: She is a master of psychological manipulation and always gets what she wants.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The report criticized the company's manipulation of the market prices.

kayitlar.explanation: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it better.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to (genetically) modify an animal.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The software can be easily modified to suit your specific needs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The club decided to modify its rules to attract more members.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Scientists are trying to modify the gene to prevent the disease.

kayitlar.meaningTr: daha ağır basmak, daha önemli olmak
kayitlar.explanation: To be greater or more important than something else.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The benefits of the new project far outweigh the costs.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: In this case, the risks of the surgery outweigh the potential advantages.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Her desire to travel outweighed her fear of flying.

kayitlar.explanation: The power of a body or plant to remain healthy when attacked by disease.
kayitlar.note:
Noun.
Kullanım: disease resistance; resistance to disease/cold/bacteria.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The new type of wheat has a high resistance to common diseases.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The government's plans met with strong resistance from the public.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Regular exercise can help build your body's resistance to infection.

kayitlar.explanation: To fight against something; to refuse to accept something.
kayitlar.note:
Verb.
Kullanım: to resist sb or sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The local residents are resisting the plan to build a new road.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: It's hard to resist the temptation to eat chocolate.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The army resisted the enemy's attack for several days.

kayitlar.explanation: Done completely and with great attention to detail.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The police are carrying out a thorough investigation into the matter.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You need to give the house a thorough cleaning before the guests arrive.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is very thorough in his work and never makes any mistakes.

kayitlar.explanation: Very much; completely and with great attention to detail.
kayitlar.note:
Adverb.
Kullanım: to test/examine/check sth thoroughly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The room had been thoroughly cleaned before the new tenants moved in.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: I thoroughly enjoyed the performance from beginning to end.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Make sure you read the contract thoroughly before signing it.

kayitlar.explanation: Enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: We have sufficient food to last us for the entire journey.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Is the evidence sufficient to prove that he is guilty?
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Make sure you get sufficient sleep before your big exam.

kayitlar.explanation: Able to do something well because of training and practice.
kayitlar.note:
Adjective.
Kullanım: to be proficient in/at (doing) sth.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: She is highly proficient in three different languages.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: With practice, you will become more proficient at playing the piano.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The job requires someone who is proficient in using computer software.

kayitlar.explanation: The ability to do something well because of training and practice.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The test measures your proficiency in English speaking and writing.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: He reached a high level of proficiency in his chosen field of study.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Proficiency in coding is becoming increasingly important in the job market.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that is suitable or right in the situation.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The situation is serious, and we must act accordingly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Please read the instructions carefully and proceed accordingly.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He was told about the changes and adjusted his plans accordingly.

kayitlar.explanation: The ability to make sensible decisions after considering the facts.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: In my judgment, we should wait until we have more information.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: You need to use your own judgment to decide which option is best.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The court will give its judgment on the case next week.

kayitlar.explanation: Decided in advance so that it does not happen by chance.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The landing spot was predetermined before the mission began.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The software follows a predetermined path to process the data.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: They had a predetermined budget for their holiday expenses.

kayitlar.explanation: A person who is the first to study or develop something.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He was a pioneer in the field of artificial intelligence.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company is a pioneer of new technologies in the energy sector.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Early pioneers of aviation faced many dangers in the sky.

kayitlar.explanation: The process of developing gradually from one stage to another.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The book describes the progression of the disease over time.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: There is a natural progression from childhood to adulthood.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: He is very happy with his career progression at the firm.

kayitlar.explanation: To fly high in the sky; to rise very quickly to a high level.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The eagle soared high above the mountains, looking for food.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: Stock prices soared to record levels after the positive news.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Pollution levels have soared in the city during the winter months.

kayitlar.explanation: To come or go down from a higher to a lower level.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The airplane began to descend as it approached the airport.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: We watched the sun descend behind the horizon in the evening.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: The climbers had to descend the mountain quickly due to the storm.

kayitlar.explanation: Showing a lack of care about danger and the consequences of your actions.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: His reckless driving put the lives of others at great risk.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The company was criticized for its reckless spending of funds.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: It was a reckless decision to go hiking in such bad weather.

kayitlar.explanation: In a way that shows a lack of care about danger.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: He spent his inheritance recklessly and was soon in debt.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The car was driven recklessly through the narrow city streets.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: She acted recklessly without thinking about the future consequences.

kayitlar.explanation: Behaviour that shows a lack of care about danger.
kayitlar.exampleSentence1: The accident was caused by the sheer recklessness of the driver.
kayitlar.exampleSentence2: The judge criticized the recklessness of the company's managers.
kayitlar.exampleSentence3: Youthful recklessness can sometimes lead to serious problems.

kayitlar.explanation: Correct and true in every detail.
